vagabond.name: Vagabond
vagabond.description: Circumstances left you wandering, with no home, no family, no friends.  But the world you knew is gone, and maybe your experiences relying on yourself to survive could be useful in this new one.

bionic_prepper.name: Bionic Survivalist
bionic_prepper.description: You knew the end was coming.  You augmented yourself with some basic bionics and got additional survival training.  Now the end has come, and it is time to see if your efforts have paid off.

unemployed.name: Survivor
unemployed.description: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you.  But you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

lonesome_drifter.name: Lonesome Drifter
lonesome_drifter.description: You thought you were just another resident of Massachusetts, until the undead came calling. Armed with blinkies, a shotgun, and a set of survival rules, you know the best way to survive is to keep moving, shoot straight, and never forget your seatbelt.  You've heard the Cataclysm hasn't reached the west, so that's where you're heading.

sheltered_survivor.name: Sheltered Survivor
sheltered_survivor.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  Now, it is winter, and you hope the rag-tag collection of skills you learned from all those books can help you survive.

sheltered_militia.name: Sheltered Militia
sheltered_militia.description: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  Now, it is winter, and you hope your guns and the skills you have acquired can help you survive.

tailor.name: Tailor
tailor.description: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.

chef.name: Chef
chef.description: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with a butchers knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.

churl.name: Churl
churl.description: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.

caveman.name: Prehistoric Hunter
caveman.description: An out-of-place living relic of prehistory, stranded in an unfamiliar and terrifying world.  Life as a hunter-gatherer was hard, but at least you didn't have to fight the living dead, and you had your kin to stand beside you.  Here, you're on your own.

prospector.name: Prospector
prospector.description: Yee haw!  Ye've struck it rich in the Cataclysm, findin' yerself a whole new world to pan fer gold in.  Just be sure to watch out fer them thar zombies and other varmints lookin' to make a meal outta ya!

frontiersman.name: Frontiersman
frontiersman.description: You set out on your first real frontier trail expecting nothing more than hard miles and open sky. Instead, a moment of blinding light stole the world you knew. Now you stand in a future ravaged by the Cataclysm, your gear outdated, your instincts untested, and your only choice to adapt fast or perish.

dogsledder.name: Dogsledder
dogsledder.description: Fresh to the long northern trails, you began your first season guiding a small team through snowbound silence and bitter wind. You expected hard lessons, frozen fingers, and the slow rhythm of life on the ice—nothing more. But one night, a burst of impossible light swallowed the horizon, and the world you knew vanished beneath it. Now you stand in a future shattered by the Cataclysm, your dogs restless at your side, your skills untested, and the cold no longer the only danger you face.

big_game_hunter.name: Big Game Hunter
big_game_hunter.description: You've bagged dangerous game on every continent, and had just set out on your latest expedition.  When you woke up in the morning, your campsite was gone.  At least you still have your trusty rifle by your side.

labtech.name: Lab Technician
labtech.description: Thanks to your time in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of conducting science.  Now that the world has ended, only one question remains: Can you undo the very Cataclysm you helped create?

bionic_labtech.name: Bionic Lab-tech
bionic_labtech.description: You've spent your career keeping up with the latest advances in science, even enrolling as a subject yourself to benefit from cutting-edge bionics that would assist your own studies.  Now however, you're starting to wish they offered courses on xenobiology.

mechanic.name: Home Mechanic
mechanic.description: You've always loved working on cars, and have been eager to tune up something special one of these days.  At least now you'll never be wanting for materials.

scoundrel.name: Scoundrel
scoundrel.description: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  But how much longer will they hold out?

beekeeper.name: Beekeeper
beekeeper.description: You used to be a professional beekeeper.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.

basketball_player.name: Basketball Player
basketball_player.description: It was going to be your first major game, but then the Cataclysm struck.  Thanks to your quick feet, you were among the lucky few to survive and escape from the creatures.

true_foodperson.name: True Foodperson
true_foodperson.description: You are the true Foodperson, some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  You are Foodperson, the mask has become your face, you are real and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

cyclist.name: Professional Cyclist
cyclist.description: You were a promising young cyclist with a bright career in front of you before this all happened.  Perhaps you'll never get to participate in the grand tours now, but as the saying goes: Life is like riding a bicycle, you got to keep moving.

professional_diver.name: Professional Diver
professional_diver.description: You spent a large part of your time exploring lakes and diving in the New England region, giving you lots of knowledge about the waters in the local area.

underwater_welder.name: Underwater Welder
underwater_welder.description: Through years of underwater welding, you've honed a deep understanding of submerged structures in the New England region.

bionic_diver.name: Bionic Marine Biologist
bionic_diver.description: You were a marine biologist who specialized in extended underwater research.  You have a bionic respirator for emergency situations where you run out of air unexpectedly, and additional implants that enable you to explore the depths easier and surgically examine marine life.

sharkboy.name: Sharkboy
sharkboy.description: You were always infatuated with bodies of water, ocean or lake. You spent your days swimming, diving, and exploring the depths. Now, you find yourself transformed into a creature of the deep. Is this what you desired?

davy_jones.name: Davy Jones
davy_jones.description: You were robbed, shot in the head and thrown into the sea just before the Cataclysm. Now you have risen undead from the depths, with a thirst for vengeance against those who wronged you, and a desire to reclaim your lost treasures.

lagoon_creature.name: Creature of the Lagoon
lagoon_creature.description: Ascending from the muck, you've been granted a new life by the Cataclysm. A far cry from your previous existence, you now find yourself a creature of the deep, struggling to understand your new form and purpose.

soldier.name: Military Rifleman
soldier.description: You were hoping to see some action, only to get more than you bargained for deployed stateside responding to a national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you to this hellhole.

soldier_wwii.name: Army Infantry
soldier_wwii.description: One moment you were scrambling for cover in a shell crater, on some burnt-out island in the Pacific.  Then a bright flash, and next thing you know you're stateside again.  Except the cities don't look anything like how you remember them, and the smell of death hangs in the air like it followed you home

mil_auto_rifleman.name: Military Automatic Rifleman
mil_auto_rifleman.description: You were trained to lay down suppressing fire, and are armed accordingly.  But they just seem to keep coming without end, you're not sure you have the firepower for this.

mil_grenadier.name: Military Grenadier
mil_grenadier.description: You were the one assigned the team's grenade launcher, something you thought was overkill for a stateside deployment at first.  Now you're starting to wish you joined the Field Artillery Branch.

mil_marksman.name: Military Designated Marksman
mil_marksman.description: You aren't a dedicated sniper, but every squad needs someone who can handle targets beyond their effective range.  Without the rest of your squad, things are getting too close quarters for your liking.

prof_combat_engineer.name: Combat Engineer
prof_combat_engineer.description: Your military training focused on field fortifications and demolitions, along with the basics on modern autonomous defenses.  You never expected to need that training on the home front, not that it's helped so far given the bots are all on free-fire mode.

prof_combat_medic.name: Military Corpsman
prof_combat_medic.description: You were trained to keep your platoon in top shape, while still having to lug all the same kit as any other soldier alongside your medical supplies.  Now you're on your own against the undead, and that rifle they saddled you with is your only line of defense.

specops.name: Special Operator
specops.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.

specops_frogman.name: Spec Ops Combat Diver
specops_frogman.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  Trained in underwater sabotage and boarding operations, you've survived where others became shark bait.  As far as you can tell, military command has left you high and dry.

military_saboteur.name: Military Saboteur
military_saboteur.description: You were transferred to the lab's security department in an advisory position.  In actuality, in the event things went wrong your orders were to locate and disable some sort of portal experiment, and issued a backpack nuke.  Unfortunately, you discovered too late that this facility doesn't contain the equipment you were looking for.

power_armor_soldier.name: Power Armor Soldier
power_armor_soldier.description: Your unit received the latest generation of power armor plating, running off those new plutonium power banks they were rolling out and equipped with experimental energy weapons.  The rest of your squad has fallen, and your exoskeleton might be a bit out of date, but your gear might see you through.

lifter_mech_pilot.name: Industrial Mech Pilot
lifter_mech_pilot.description: You were recently certified to pilot an industrial and combat engineering model of the Mechanical Exoskeleton Suits the military had been developing.  It's not armed, but it might still be useful despite the heavy use its power cell has been through.

combat_mech_pilot.name: Combat Mech Pilot
combat_mech_pilot.description: You were field-testing the latest in military firepower, with Mechanical Exoskeleton Suits planned to fill the niche left after power armor development shifted to lighter models.  Your mech's built to lay down heavy fire support, but the power cell the technicians provided has been mostly depleted from earlier tests.

recon_mech_pilot.name: Recon Mech Pilot
recon_mech_pilot.description: You were field-testing the latest in military firepower, with Mechanical Exoskeleton Suits planned to fill the niche left after power armor development shifted to lighter models.  Your mech's built for scouting and sniping, but the power cell the technicians provided has been mostly depleted from earlier tests.

maid.description: You worked in a wealthy household, but after the Cataclysm they took a family vacation to an unknown place, leaving you to fend for yourself.

captive.description: You were following a road at night trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  As you stepped away to investigate, you suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this place… Are you even on earth anymore?

rescuer.description: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  But now as you walk through those strange corridors, the atmosphere grows heavy and you're not so sure anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue now.

migo_escapee.name: Escapee
migo_escapee.description: You've been held in this alien hellhole for a couple days, picking at the walls until you found a loose piece you could fashion into a shiv.  You're getting dizzy from the stifling heat and fumes, it's now or never.

migo_experiment.name: Test Subject
migo_experiment.description: You've lost track of how long they've kept you here.  They did something to you, you only remember blacking out from pain when they started to cut you open.  You woke up unable to feel pain or much else, and the air feels lighter than it used to, but you don't intend to gamble on surviving a second round of surgery.

medic.name: Medical Resident
medic.description: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience.  You just hope it will be enough if the old adage of 'Doctor, heal thyself' ends up being required.

gangster.name: Gangster
gangster.description: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  A shame he didn't manage it, himself.  No stranger to a spot of violence, you almost feel at home in this new world already.

smuggler.name: Smuggler
smuggler.description: Ever since the heat (both climate and police presence) got too bad in Miami, you found a niche running all sorts of tax-free goods into New England.  You're used to outrunning the cops, but now both the pigs and your clientele want your brains instead of your product.

security.name: Security Guard
security.description: A low paid security guard, things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous than patrolling the grounds warding off potential thieves.  You don't have many particularly useful skills, but you do have some useful equipment since you were on the job when things started going south.

groundskeeper.name: Landscaper
groundskeeper.description: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left but your tools and expertise.

homemaker.name: Nursing Assistant
homemaker.description: You were providing in-home care for the elderly, even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…

survivalist.name: Survivalist
survivalist.description: Skilled at surviving off the land far from civilization, your skills are quite likely to come in useful considering civilization is now full of monsters that want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile - and with your skills, more than you need…  except your canteen's run out!

smoker.name: Chain Smoker
smoker.description: Everyone at work knew you as the person who always had a cigarette or two in hand.  Now, you're down to a single pack, and you hope you find more soon.  You start out with a strong nicotine addiction.

crackhead.name: Crackhead
crackhead.description: Cocaine.  It is, indeed, a helluva drug.  You blew your money on some dust, and before you knew it you were turning tricks behind the local CVS just to score one more line.

homeless.name: Hobo
homeless.description: Society drove you to the fringes and set you wandering, with no home, no family, no friends, until you could only find solace in the bottom of a bottle.  But society doesn't mean a thing anymore, and for all the crap thrown your way, you're still standing.  God damn, you need a drink.

dumpster_diver.name: Dumpster Diver
dumpster_diver.description: Before the Cataclysm, you lived off what others threw away. Now that the world has leveled the playing field, your eye for salvage makes you a survivor, not a beggar.

crypto_millionaire.name: Crypto Millionaire
crypto_millionaire.description: Before the Cataclysm, you were a shut-in NEET who struck gold on an obscure cryptocoin. Money couldn’t buy you friends or fitness, but it filled your apartment with gadgets, snacks, and time to waste. When the world ended, your fortune meant nothing—except the gear you had the sense (or luck) to keep close.

fashion_model.name: Fashion Model
fashion_model.description: Once worshiped for looks, not survival skills. Now that the world has leveled the playing field, glamour won’t save you.

tweaker.name: Tweaker
tweaker.description: You're not entirely sure what happened, but everything has gone to shit, and the only thing running through your head is where you're gonna find your next hit.

pillhead.name: Pillhead
pillhead.description: After an accident in your youth, you got addicted to the opiates treating your pain.  With the pharmacies shut down and dealers turned undead, satisfying your fix just got a lot more difficult.

el_eng.name: Electrical Engineer
el_eng.description: Fresh out of college, you've got little in the way of practical engineering experience.  The Cataclysm might prove to be a rather complicated problem to solve even from an engineering perspective, and you're not sure if you can solder your way out of this one.

mech_eng.name: Mechanical Engineer
mech_eng.description: Fresh out of college, you've got little in the way of practical engineering experience.  The Cataclysm might prove to be a rather complicated problem to solve even from an engineering perspective, and you're not sure if you will pass this stress test.

heli_pilot.name: Pilot
heli_pilot.description: You’ve spent years in the cockpit, guiding passengers, cargo, or your own craft through the skies. The Cataclysm has grounded you, but the thrill of flight still calls…

heli_pilot_scenario.name: Helicopter Pilot
heli_pilot_scenario.description: You earned a living ferrying businesspeople and tourists from helipad to helipad, now your flying skills are all you have to rely on.

plane_pilot_scenario.name: Plane Pilot
plane_pilot_scenario.description: You once soared above cities and fields, transporting passengers and cargo between airports.

floatplane_pilot_scenario.name: Floatplane Pilot
floatplane_pilot_scenario.description: You always loved the view of the open water from high above.  Now you have to worry about what might be lurking below the surface when you land.

blimp_pilot_scenario.name: Blimp Pilot
blimp_pilot_scenario.description: You once piloted a newscasting blimp, drifting above cities and fields to capture stories from the skies.

medic_pilot.name: Medevac Pilot
medic_pilot.description: As a first responder piloting a medical chopper, you had a birds-eye view of how bad things were getting.  Just when you thought you'd seen the worst of it, patients that were DOA started clawing their way out of their body bags, and dispatch gave a panicked message about the hospitals being overrun before the radio went silent.

gyro_pilot.name: Gyrocopter Pilot
gyro_pilot.description: You always loved tinkering with flying machines as a hobby.  With your gyrocopter and what little flight gear you could scrounge up while the world was ending, the sky's the limit.

bird_pilot.name: Avian Heli Pilot
bird_pilot.description: When the world ended, you thought your piloting experience would keep you safe.  Then the feathers starting growing out.  You must've poked your nose (wait, beak!?) where it didn't belong during one of your stops to refuel.  At least now you have a backup plan if your ride fails you.

k9_cop.name: K9 Officer
k9_cop.description: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended and none of that matters anymore.  But at least you have a loyal friend.

dog_lover.name: Dog Lover
dog_lover.description: You spent your days running around with your faithful dogs by your side.  When the world ended, you grabbed your companions along with some of their things to protect them.  The zombies could be nearby, but at least your canine friends shouldn't have to worry about the rain.

crazy_cat_lady.description: Everyone is dead?  Well, it doesn't matter… your cats are all the friends you need!

cop.name: Police Officer
cop.description: Just a small-town deputy when you got the call, you were still ready to come to the rescue.  Except that soon it was you who needed rescuing - you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?

detective.name: Police Detective
detective.description: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your last homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now that suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You need a smoke.

detective_scen.name: Police Detective
detective_scen.description: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your last homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now that suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You need a smoke.

swat.name: SWAT Officer
swat.description: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the breakdown of society has brought you to your current state of affairs; you now fight to simply stay alive.

swat_heavy.name: SWAT CQC Specialist
swat_heavy.description: A member of the police force's most elite division, your close quarters combat training has kept you alive thus far.  Unfortunately, the breakdown of society has brought you to your current state of affairs; you now fight to simply stay alive.

sniper_police.name: Police Sniper
sniper_police.description: Your skill as a sharpshooter served you well in the line of duty, protecting the innocent with a single, well placed bullet.  Now survival itself is on the line, and you can't afford to miss if you don't want to end up as something's dinner.

riot_police.name: Riot Control Officer
riot_police.description: The riots were brutal, and that's before the dead rose and started to devour the living.  Soon it became apparent that the line you were holding was about to break - it was only through a bit of luck and a lot of head-bashing that you got away in one piece, and the worst is yet to come.

salesman.name: Used Car Salesman
salesman.description: You've been accused of being the sort of person who'd be willing to sell your own mother for a dollar.  It always left you insulted - you've been around the block a time or two, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!

bow_hunter.name: Bow Hunter
bow_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you soon took a liking to the challenge of hunting with a bow.  Why, if the world ended there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

crossbow_hunter.name: Crossbow Hunter
crossbow_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you soon took a liking to the challenge of hunting with a crossbow.  Why, if the world ended there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty crossbow.  So when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

shotgun_hunter.name: Shotgun Hunter
shotgun_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you soon took a liking to the challenge of hunting with a shotgun.  Why, if the world ended there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

rifle_hunter.name: Rifle Hunter
rifle_hunter.description: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you soon took a liking to the challenge of hunting with a rifle.  Why, if the world ended there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So when it did, you made sure to bring it along.

construction_worker.description: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did a lot of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help it rebuild?

trucker.name: Trucker
trucker.description: You ruled the road in your big rig and managed to drive it somewhere you hoped was safe when the riots hit.  Now it's just you and your trusty truck cab.

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lumberjack.description: You're a lumberjack, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, but suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.

backpacker.name: Backpacker
backpacker.description: You've traveled for a living, sightseeing here and there, and living off your parents' trust fund.  But now they're gone, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.

fastfoodcook.name: Fast Food Cook
fastfoodcook.description: You used to work at a fancy fast food joint a week ago, but now you show the meaning of "fast" food by running for your life.

electrician.name: Electrician
electrician.description: You used to work for some small-time business owners doing minor electrical work, and were on your way to another trivial job when the Cataclysm struck.  The power's out, but if you survive long enough you might be able to improvise.

hacker.name: Computer Hacker
hacker.description: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen have given you skills in an area that seem, on the face of it, distinctly less-than-useful when the world has ended.  Unless you manage to find a military mainframe.

robot_tech.name: Robot Technician
robot_tech.description: You worked as a robotics technician, keeping drones and machines running and once even slipped a control laptop out of the lab for yourself. After the world fell, your skill to repair and command broken robots makes you as valuable and dangerous as any weapon.

pentester.name: Penetration Tester
pentester.description: Years of sneaking past digital defenses and exploiting software vulnerabilities taught you to manipulate systems others couldn’t touch. Now, in a world of silent servers and dormant machinery, those same skills let you turn abandoned tech into tools, weapons, or even allies.

student.name: Student
student.description: You were a high school student, but the tests you'll face now will have much higher stakes.  There might even be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.

student_with_books.name: Library Nerd
student_with_books.description: They say reading is food for the brain, but those corpses seem to see your brain as food.  In your haste to escape, you grabbed the library's return box, but is there anything in there that might help you?

svictim.name: Shower Victim
svictim.description: You were in the middle of a nice, hot shower when the Cataclysm struck!  You barely managed to escape with some soap and the most massively useful thing ever…  a towel.

biker.name: Biker
biker.description: You spent most of your life on a Harley, out on the open road with your club.  Now they're all dead.  Time to ride or die.

dancer.name: Ballroom Dancer
dancer.description: You used to be a ballroom dancer before the Cataclysm, and now you use your skills to save your life.

bionic_thief.name: Bionic Thief
bionic_thief.description: You have done many high profile heists, but your gains mean nothing in this world.  All you have left are the tools of your trade and your impeccable style.

bionic_patient.name: Bionic Patient
bionic_patient.description: When the diagnosis came back positive you signed up for a series of experimental bionic surgeries that saved your life.  Now you're healthier than you ever were before, thanks to a suite of bionic systems powered by your own metabolic functions.  Make the most of your second chance at life.

patient.name: Patient
patient.description: When the diagnosis came back positive, you were willing to fight to keep living.  Now, you must renew your vow of tenacity in these new times.

mutant_patient.name: Unwilling Mutant
mutant_patient.description: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.

mutant_volunteer.name: Volunteer Mutant
mutant_volunteer.description: Your dreams of becoming a super-human mutant through genetic alteration may have fallen a bit short, but when the Cataclysm struck, you and the scientists were ready to put your new body to the test.

wolfpack_mutant.name: Mutant Pack Leader
wolfpack_mutant.description: They treated you like an animal in that lab.  Now that you're free, you wonder if they had the right idea.  Your new friends don't seem afraid of you like they are of humans, after all.

broken_cyborg.name: Defective Cyborg
broken_cyborg.description: You were normal once.  Before the tests, before the procedures, before they stripped away every outward sign of your humanity.  You're more machine than man now, but that might prove an advantage against the horrors that await.

bionic_worker.name: Industrial Cyborg
bionic_worker.description: For better or for worse, bionic augmentation has turned you into a walking power tool.  Upgraded with a standard industrial-grade manual labor surgery and training package, you are augmented with bionic muscles and an integrated toolset, both powered by standard batteries.

bionic_athlete.name: Bionic Athlete
bionic_athlete.description: It's a shame the apocalypse happened; you'll never get a shot at the Cyberolympics.  Now the only thing between you and death by zombie is your freakish cyborg strength.

bionic_runner.name: Bionic Runner
bionic_runner.description: You were that kind of sportsman who couldn't get off the track.  You love running, and you enhanced your body to do it even better.  Now there is plenty to run from, but this is your kind of game.

bionic_cop.name: Bionic Police Officer
bionic_cop.description: Mortally injured in the line of duty, you were resurrected by the surgeons from the department's revolutionary Cybercop program.  Now, in these lawless times, you are truly the future of law enforcement.

bionic_firefighter.name: Bionic Firefighter
bionic_firefighter.description: As a second-generation augmented firefighter, you have been cybernetically enhanced to operate in the most dire of emergency situations.  The end of the world definitely counts as a dire situation.

bionic_mentat.name: Bionic Boffin
bionic_mentat.description: Prior to the apocalypse you were employed by a major international corporation as a representative and technical advisor, utilizing the incredible power of your cybernetically augmented mind.

bio_soldier.name: Bionic Soldier
bio_soldier.description: You are the result of one of the military's latest and final research programs, a prototype cyborg soldier.  You're still alive thanks to your augmentations, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.

bio_sniper.name: Bionic Sniper
bio_sniper.description: Your bionics, equipment, and extensive field training enable you to drop targets from implausible distances, even after weeks of total isolation in enemy territory.

bio_specops.name: Bionic Operator
bio_specops.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest, and your bionics have only enhanced your abilities.  Specializing in close quarters combat, you were sent on the most dangerous and critical missions.

bionic_spy.name: Bionic Agent
bionic_spy.description: Your body has several bionics worth millions of dollars, paid for by public taxes.  The government has turned you into an infiltration and recon specialist: you have night vision, an alarm, an infolink, lock picking capabilities and a hacking module.  And a killswitch in case you went rogue, but with your handlers dead you're the only one left who knows its activation phrase.

bionic_hitman.name: Bionic Assassin
bionic_hitman.description: The product of millions of dollars of clandestine research, you are a bionic sleeper agent capable of silently engaging your target while maintaining an innocuous appearance.  If compromised while hunting high-priority targets, you were also provided with a killswitch guaranteed to take them with you.

bio_gangster.name: Bionic Gangster
bio_gangster.description: You were the boss' favorite, their protege; they always counted on you to get the toughest jobs done.  Seeing your potential, they invested in "basic" augments and the best gear on the market to better aid you in your job.  After enjoying some period of freedom to do as you wanted, now you find yourself needing those skills to survive.

bio_gunslinger.name: Bionic Gunslinger
bio_gunslinger.description: Lynched but not killed for a crime you didn't commit, you underwent augmentation surgery and hunted down those responsible with your trusty laser pistol. Now the Cataclysm is here, and it's you, your cybernetics and your gun against the world.

faulty_bionic.name: Failed Cyborg
faulty_bionic.description: Your body is a wreck of bionic parts.  You have a large capacity for power, but are filled with broken bionics.  At least your ethanol power supply still works.

bionic_customer.name: Commercial Cyborg
bionic_customer.description: You always had to have the latest and best gadgets and gizmos, so is it any wonder that you upgraded your flesh along with your smart phone?  Only time will tell if your passion for electronics and your status as a marvel of bionic technology will be enough to ensure your survival after the apocalypse.

hitchhiker.name: Hitchhiker
hitchhiker.description: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.

trapper.name: Trapper
trapper.description: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living off of your catches, and trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.description: You were going through your community college's metalsmithing program when the world ended.  You ran into trouble coming out of class - but managed to keep ahold of the equipment you were carrying at the time.

clown.name: Clown
clown.description: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There's precious few balloon animals in your future now.

lost_sub.name: Lost Submissive
lost_sub.description: Early in the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there's no safewords in the apocalypse.

senior.name: Senior Citizen
senior.description: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.

cosplay.name: Otaku
cosplay.description: Late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks has prepared you for the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  It just had to be the day of the apocalypse.  At least you were ready in case your costume tore.

prof_fursuiter.name: Fursuiter
prof_fursuiter.description: You had plans to attend a local convention after your custom order finally arrived, only to find the world is ending.  You're starting to wish the company you bought this from made something armored and scaly instead.

spouse.description: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!

punkrockgirl.description: The apocalypse has been your psychotic dream come true.  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!

firefighter.name: Firefighter
firefighter.description: As a first responder you were direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  Separated from most of your equipment and your unit while on call, you were forced to fight your way to safety with little more than your trusty iron and bunker gear to protect you.

skaboy.description: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie, now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.

rioter.name: Rioter
rioter.description: The first protest you were at started peaceful, until they hosed the crowd down with machinegun fire instead of water cannons.  You escaped, and came prepared for a fight next time.  You weren't prepared for the cops and protesters to tear themselves apart in a cannibalistic frenzy.

postman.name: Mail Carrier
postman.description: Your skill at avoiding dogs and discarded children's toys while delivering the mail gives you an edge in your new role as a survivor.

convict.name: Convict
convict.description: The Cataclysm gave you a chance to escape, but freedom comes with a steep price.

death_row_convict.name: Death Row Convict
death_row_convict.description: You were a serial killer ready to walk the green mile, but now everyone else is dead, and since true death comes only from your hands, you're in for a job.

convict_embezzler.name: Embezzler
convict_embezzler.description: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, except right now they're dead and you're not.

convict_drugs.name: Meth Cook
convict_drugs.description: You clawed your way out of poverty by selling products everyone wanted, and they had the nerve to put you in jail for it.  Too bad you can't sell drugs to zombies or aliens.

convict_political.name: Political Prisoner
convict_political.description: Exposing what was going on in those labs was a noble idea.  You insist you could have stopped the Cataclysm if it weren't for that misdemeanor charge.

convict_ratman.description: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.

burglar.name: Burglar
burglar.description: You thought this would be your lucky break.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?

razorgirl.description: Through a series of painful and expensive surgeries you became a walking bionic weapon, your services as a mercenary available to the highest bidder.  Now that the world has ended, those bionic enhancements may spell the difference between life and death.

cyberjunkie.name: Cyberjunkie
cyberjunkie.description: Long ago your lifelong infatuation with bionic enhancement lead you into a shady world of back-alley bionic clinics and self-installed secondhand CBMs.  The world has moved on but your posthuman hunger still cries out to be fed; where will you get your bionic fix now?

cykotic.name: Bionic Monster
cykotic.description: Completely overtaken by bionic-induced psychosis, you are a deformed posthuman monster who had no place in society.  But now, where once you were forced to hide in the shadows, you find in this new desolation a world where even a creature such as yourself might find its niche.

lawyer.name: Lawyer
lawyer.description: Now instead of complaining about your fees, your clients try to eat your brain.  You can't tell which one is worse though.

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: When the apocalypse struck, you did everything you could to protect your parish faithful, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.

shinto_priest.name: Kannushi
shinto_priest.description: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.

imam.description: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran, and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you, now they come to eat your brains.

rabbi.name: Rabbi
rabbi.description: You were celebrating with your flock in the temple when the Cataclysm struck.  You sure could use a messiah right now!

guru.name: Guru
guru.description: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally, you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

preacher.name: Preacher
preacher.description: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now, everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast and the undead listening to your sermons don't seem particularly moved.

blackbelt_novice.name: Novice Martial Artist
blackbelt_novice.description: You were on your way to the dojo for your first lesson when the world ended.  And you really wanted to learn how to swim, too.

blackbelt_intermediate.name: Martial Artist
blackbelt_intermediate.description: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!

blackbelt.name: Blackbelt
blackbelt.description: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.

worlds_greatest.name: World's Greatest Athlete
worlds_greatest.description: Your name reverberated across the world as you set record after record in the Olympics, becoming the greatest of all time. Alas, even with your face plastered across billboards and cereals, the zombies are still more interested in turning you into gold medalist goulash.

boxer.name: Boxer
boxer.description: You were training for the fight of your life before the Cataclysm struck.  Now you fight just to keep yourself alive.

pizzaboy.description: You were delivering the last pizza of the night to the local cryogenics lab when the Cataclysm hit.  Fleeing to the nearest shelter, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!

archaeologist.name: Archaeologist
archaeologist.description: While on your way to a long-lost temple following a clue from your dead grandfather's journal, the ground started to shake uncontrollably.  Getting a bad feeling about the situation, you head to the nearest shelter.

archaeologist_scen.name: Archaeologist
archaeologist_scen.description: While on your way to a long-lost temple following a clue from your dead grandfather's journal, the ground started to shake uncontrollably.  Getting a bad feeling about the situation, you head to the nearest shelter.

paperboy.description: You were delivering the morning paper along your usual route when the Cataclysm struck.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.

rollerderby.name: Roller Derby Player
rollerderby.description: You were hell on wheels prior to the apocalypse.  Now the rest of your team is dead, and you probably wouldn't have lived this long if not for your penchant for high-speed violence.  Things are looking grim; how long can you race laps around the undead before you get blocked for good?

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: You were making a living by raising crops, when the Cataclysm struck.  Now, with your trusty hoe and some seeds it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.

national_guard.name: National Guard
national_guard.description: Your National Guard unit was activated when the epidemic struck.  Despite your best efforts you did not manage to meet up with them before all communications ceased and you found yourself alone amongst the dead.

hardened_survivor.name: Hardened Survivor
hardened_survivor.description: One of the lucky few who escaped the cataclysm, you made a life for yourself living off nature's bounties and what you could get outside the death traps of the large cities.

winter_scavenger.name: Hardened Scavenger
winter_scavenger.description: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself on the ruins of others.  Whether by force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.

road_warrior.name: Road Warrior
road_warrior.description: You lived by your wheels during the first few months of the apocalypse, now you're running low on ammo and fuel, and your situation is dire.  You've been reduced to a scavenger, living off the corpse of the old world.

waste_ranger.name: Wasteland Ranger
waste_ranger.description: If the human race is to survive, the threats facing its existence must be eliminated, no matter the cost.  If it's hostile, you kill it.

player_bandit.name: Veteran Bandit
player_bandit.description: After the cities exploded there was a whirlwind of looting; a firestorm of fear.  Men began to feed on men.  On the roads it was a white line nightmare.  Looting, killing, drug-running, one way or another you'll live and die on your bike.

winter_army.name: Military Holdout
winter_army.description: You must have paid attention to your survival training in boot camp, otherwise you would never have lived long enough to outlast the chain of command and find yourself in this predicament.  The only mission left now is to survive.

monster_hunter.name: Monster Hunter
monster_hunter.description: With the fall of civilization, you took to living off the land and grew into a competent hunter.  The abominations that thrive in this new world may not be good eating, but their hides and bones make for quite practical trophies.

monster_slayer.name: Monster Slayer
monster_slayer.description: With the fall of civilization, you took to living off the land and honed your skills fending off undead and worse.  You wear the fruits of your labor proudly, bearing weapons and armor made from the bones of great beasts.

mall_cop.name: Mall Security
mall_cop.description: A mall security guard.  You don't have any useful skills, other than some basic training for your job.  You do however have your trusty tazer, baton, and pocket knife.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.description: You have come to an understanding with Mother Nature over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: You always preferred the comfort of the open sky, far from the complexities of modern life.  Though from the looks of it, things have changed since last time you've been anywhere near civilization.

castaway.name: Castaway
castaway.description: You were shipwrecked out on an island in the lake.  No one sent a search party, so after weeks of trying to signal for help you salvaged every scrap of clothing you could to set sail on a makeshift raft.  Where is everyone, and why do the sharks look so hungry?

fisher.name: Fisher
fisher.description: You spent most of your days just fishing in the swamps getting by quietly on what you caught.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but they got bigger and more mean.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked- you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.

reenactor.name: Historical Reenactor
reenactor.description: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.

reenactor2.name: Ahistorical Reenactor
reenactor2.description: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.

prof_ninja.name: Ninja
prof_ninja.description: Your cosplay may be more theatrical than historical, less shinobi and more kabuki stagehand, but your weapons are real enough.  Tread lightly, but remember they hunt by scent too.

prof_pirate.name: Pirate
prof_pirate.description: Arr!  Your costume may be shipshape, but the end of the world's scuppered all your plans.  Strike up your Jolly Roger and hoist the Bloody Red, for no quarter shall be given.

prof_pirate_captain.name: Pirate Captain
prof_pirate_captain.description: Land ho!  Ye went all out on the reenactment, got your letters of marque in order and cast off in a fine sloop, to prowl the New England waters with.

drone_op.name: Bionic Robot Technician
drone_op.description: You had a job programming machines such as automatic street cleaners, newsbots and pizza delivery drones, and you were bionically augmented to do so hands-free.  Now all the drones carry guns instead of pizza.

skaterkid.name: Rollerblader
skaterkid.description: You love to skate!  At least now the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

skaterkid_board.name: Skateboarder
skaterkid_board.description: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

jdelinquent.name: Juvenile Delinquent
jdelinquent.description: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, and that's how you ended up spending most of your days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.

jr_survivalist.name: Survivalist Jr.
jr_survivalist.description: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive to see bright nights again.

bionic_student.name: Bionic Student
bionic_student.description: Your parents were so obsessed with making sure you aced every test that they had you outfitted with bionics to make you smarter and never forget anything.  And now, you are facing the most dire test yet, and once again you had better succeed, or else.

dodgeball_player.name: Dodgeball Player
dodgeball_player.description: You liked to play dodgeball, where failing to dodge the ball meant you were out.  Now failing to dodge threatens your life.  Don't slip up.

science_club_mem.name: Science Club Member
science_club_mem.description: You were a member of the school science club, and right now you're as upset as you've ever been that the school wouldn't let you play with the really fun chemicals that make things go boom.  At least now no one's around to tell you that you can't.

av_club_mem.name: A/V Club Member
av_club_mem.description: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.description: You've been teaching kids for the whole of your life, and they've mostly listened to your teachings.  However, the dead won't write out lines for eating you alive.

photojournalist.name: Photojournalist
photojournalist.description: You were a freelance photojournalist before the end.  You have a chance to be the first journalist to cover the apocalypse, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera, hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.

gym_teacher.name: Gym Teacher
gym_teacher.description: After a career of teaching kids the art of sports they mostly hate, the zombies around you refuse to do laps, even at the blow of your whistle.

camper.name: Camper
camper.description: You always enjoyed hiking and camping in the wilderness before everything fell apart, so it was a no-brainer to grab your bag and run when the sirens sounded.  The world may be ruined, but you're prepared to make a home wherever you may find yourself.

rv_camper.name: RV Camper
rv_camper.description: You always enjoyed life on the road, driving across the country to see the wonders of nature.  Now nature seems a lot more hostile, and it's a lot harder to get your RV hooked up to shore power.

van_camper.name: Van Camper
van_camper.description: You decided to hit the road and never look back, living in the back of a van.  Now instead of worrying about someone knocking on your window at night, you have to worry about zombies mistaking your ride for canned food.

miner.name: Miner
miner.description: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your jackhammer may be gassed up, but your canteen is dry, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…

demolition_expert.name: Demolition Expert
demolition_expert.description: Before this all began you were having the time of your life at your dream job, blowing things up.  Now you're finally allowed to do it full time.

parkour_practitioner.description: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.

tourist.name: Tourist
tourist.description: You came here to get a taste of New England; Now you hope New England won't get a taste of you!

naked.name: Naked and Afraid
naked.description: You were out filming a reality TV show in the woods and the cast and crew all seemed to have turned into zombies.  Looks like it's for real now…

bionic_installer.name: Augmentation Associate
bionic_installer.description: When bionics first emerged, you were quick to make them into your career, and spent your days overseeing their installation.  As one of the few non-zombies in the world that can calibrate an Autodoc, your skills might come in handy now that the world is over.

game_master.name: Game Master
game_master.description: Trying to herd cats into getting into one place every week has taught you something: it's usually better to cut your losses and trust your gut.  For that reason, when you had two no-shows and the other two tried to eat you, you ditched.  Maybe you can find some new players in the ruins of the world.

bionic_game_master.name: Bionic Game Master
bionic_game_master.description: You came into a large fortune, through luck or will, and hosted games for people that most of the world knew on a first-name basis.  You could afford to spoil your players, and so you did.  You invested in bionics to make you smarter, and memorized the entire handbook.  Let's hope that knowledge helps you now.

zoo_keeper.name: Zoo Keeper
zoo_keeper.description: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo because none of your coworkers showed up for work for one reason or another.

golfer.name: Golfer
golfer.description: You decided to get away from the family for the day to do a little golfing by yourself.  You were almost done playing the back nine when you called to check on them and realized you couldn't get a signal.

bio_medic.name: Bionic Surgeon
bio_medic.description: As one of the top surgeons in the country, you were chosen for an augmentation program to expand the medical field.  With your expertise and augmentations, you can perform precise surgery with little assistance.

urban_samurai.name: Urban Samurai
urban_samurai.description: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, always with the funny hair, always wearing what appeared to be some kind of Japanese bathrobe.  Some claimed you were a visiting Shinto god.  Little of this concerns you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.

fencer.name: Competitive Fencer
fencer.description: You were an avid sport fencer, always practicing at local clubs and competing in tournaments.  You were on your way to have a few bouts at the club when the world ended.  Now you're in your most important tournament, the refs are all dead, and none of your opponents follow the rules.

politician.name: Career Politician
politician.description: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.

rancher.name: Rancher
rancher.description: You've spent your life tending to cows, but the world has bigger plans for you now. Time to see where your skills - and a little luck - will take you next.

roadie.name: Roadie
roadie.description: You worked just outside of the limelight, ensuring that the performers got what they needed and that everything ran smoothly.  The stakes are higher these days, but the show must go on.

musician.name: Musician
musician.description: You were just about to hit the stage when the Cataclysm struck.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.

kit_survivor.name: Kitted Survivor
kit_survivor.description: At the local mall, you saw a sign advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now, it's all you have.

gunslinger.name: Wild West Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty 6-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.

frat.description: You were living the high life, spending your parents money without a care in the world.  You were at one of your usual crazy parties when the guests became hungry for more than your drugs.  You still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.

mili_pilot.name: Military Pilot
mili_pilot.description: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.

mili_pilot_blackhawk.name: UH-60 Blackhawk Pilot
mili_pilot_blackhawk.description: You managed to get to your UH-60.  Your co-pilot didn't.  You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next, but now it's just you and your bird.

fighter_pilot.name: Fighter Pilot
fighter_pilot.description: They had you pushing your aircraft to the breaking point dropping ordinance on the undead.  After a mid-air collision forced you to eject, you were picked up by the unit you were providing air support for only for them to be wiped out to the last man.

fighter_pilot_f35.name: F-35 Fighter Pilot
fighter_pilot_f35.description: You thought the end of the world would see you dueling the PLAAF while ICBMs streak overhead.  Instead the end was a long day of desperate sorties as monstrosities swarmed every city within your craft's operational range.  Your airbase was overrun too, and every landing strip just seems more hostile than the last.

fighter_pilot_f15e.name: F-15E Fighter Pilot
fighter_pilot_f15e.description: You thought the end of the world would see you dueling the PLAAF while ICBMs streak overhead.  Instead the end was a long day of desperate sorties as monstrosities swarmed every city within your craft's operational range.  Your airbase was overrun too, and every landing strip just seems more hostile than the last.

fighter_pilot_av8.name: AV-8 Fighter Pilot
fighter_pilot_av8.description: You thought the end of the world would see you dueling the PLAAF while ICBMs streak overhead.  Instead the end was a long day of desperate sorties as monstrosities swarmed every city within your craft's operational range.  Your airbase was overrun too, and every landing strip just seems more hostile than the last.

hitman.description: You were a killer for hire, trained and equipped to efficiently eliminate your target while keeping a low profile.  No one's hiring now that the world's ended, but your skills may prove useful for staying alive.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: You were the best undercover agent they had, sent on missions so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  You've lost contact with your handler, you are all alone now.

prof_feral_unemployed.name: Feral Survivor
prof_feral_unemployed.description: They used to say that there's nothing particularly notable about you.  But you survived, and they didn't.  You made sure of that.

prof_feral_scientist.name: Feral Scientist
prof_feral_scientist.description: You learned quite a few things back in those old labs.  You know now why the world ended.  You just need a better equipment and you can prove to whoever's left you were right all along.

prof_feral_cop.name: Feral Police Officer
prof_feral_cop.description: You were just a small-town deputy.  You got caught up in the riots, and now you're the only law left in this town.  The crime is life.  The sentence is death.

prof_feral_firefighter.name: Feral Firefighter
prof_feral_firefighter.description: As a first responder you were direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  You still feel the fire, burning the pit of your stomach.  It was a pleasure to burn.

prof_feral_mechanic.name: Feral Mechanic
prof_feral_mechanic.description: You've always loved cars.  Now you'll never be wanting for materials.  The machine speaks to you, commanding you to build it.

prof_feral_biker.name: Feral Biker
prof_feral_biker.description: You lived on the open road with your motorcycle club.  They're dead and you're not.  Any bastard that tries to touch your ride will join them.

prof_feral_survivalist.name: Feral Survivalist
prof_feral_survivalist.description: Your skills are quite likely to come in useful considering civilization is now full of monsters that want you dead.  The feeling's mutual, you'll kill whoever or whatever poses a threat to you.

prof_feral_soldier.name: Feral Soldier
prof_feral_soldier.description: As far as you can tell, command abandoned you to this hellhole.  How can you take care of a bunch of panicked civilians in need of assistance with no backup?  Easy, you just don't lead 'em so much.

prof_feral_cyborg.name: Feral Cyborg
prof_feral_cyborg.description: Completely overtaken by bionic-induced psychosis, you are a deformed posthuman monster who had no place in society.  Was that your excuse all along, was it the machine that drove you mad or were you always mad?  Or did it all start when the world ended?  You can't remember anymore.

prof_feral_mutant.name: Feral Mutant
prof_feral_mutant.description: You dreamed of becoming a super-human mutant through genetic alteration.  Who cares if you're a freak of nature now?  All you need is flesh and blood.

prof_feral_maid.description: You worked in a wealthy household, but after the Cataclysm your employer had an unfortunate accident.  What a shame, they would've loved the tender flesh you've since learned to cook.

prof_feral_socialite.name: Feral Socialite
prof_feral_socialite.description: Elegant as always, the end of the world hardly fazed you at all.  Your entourage is as lively as ever, just a bit peckish.  Best to not keep them waiting, let the hunt begin.

prof_feral_armored.name: Feral Reenactor
prof_feral_armored.description: You were all set to attend the faire, only for these impudent knaves to spoil your fun.  With mace in hand, may steel meet blood and bone.

prof_feral_lumberjack.name: Feral Chainsaw Maniac
prof_feral_lumberjack.description: You felled trees before the world ended, but now there's so much more you could be doing.  When your work's finally finished, who will survive, and what will be left of them?

urbex.name: Urban Explorer
urbex.description: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next trip into town when the end of the world made your hobby much more relevant.

convict_escape_team.name: Escape Team
convict_escape_team.description: You’ve convinced a few convicts to join your escape. The guards have been acting strangely these past months, but who would have guessed the real threat would be the undead patrolling the yard?

mutant_escape_team_lab.name: Mutant Escape Team
mutant_escape_team_lab.description: You’ve convinced a few fellow test subjects to join your escape. The lab personnel have been acting strangely these past months, but who would have guessed the real threat would be the undead patrolling the halls?

escape_team_migo.name: Escape Team
escape_team_migo.description: You and your fellow captives have been held in this alien hellhole for a couple days, picking at the walls until you found a loose piece you could fashion into a shiv.  Your group is getting dizzy from the heat and fumes, it's now or never.

graffiti_crew.name: Graffiti Crew
graffiti_crew.description: You and your fellow street artists have survived the initial chaos by sticking together. Now there's much more pressing matters than being caught by the police.

heist_crew.name: Heist Crew
heist_crew.description: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now you've got one last job.

neighborhood_watch.name: Neighborhood Watch
neighborhood_watch.description: You always knew the end was coming - maybe not zombies, but something bad. Between late-night doomsday movies, cheap beer, and greasy pizza, you talked your neighbors into taking it seriously. When it all went down, you grabbed the truck, called the boys, and swore you’d keep the neighborhood safe. Now it’s time to put those plans into action.

exterminator.name: Exterminator
exterminator.description: Before the world fell apart, you were the first line of defense against roaches, rats, and worse. Armed with sprays, traps, and a healthy dose of stubbornness, you knew every trick in the book for clearing infestations. Now, your skills have never been more relevant - the pests are bigger, meaner, and sometimes hungry for you.

hazmat_unit.name: Hazmat Unit
hazmat_unit.description: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.

mili_burner.name: Military Corpse Disposal
mili_burner.description: In response to the outbreak, you were dispatched to contain the infection by burning the corpses.  With command consumed by the undead, your priorities have shifted to basic survival.

major-general.name: Major General
major-general.description: You worked your way up through the ranks from a no-name private to a big shot Major General, respected and decorated.  On the downside, years of desk duty have left your shooting skills rusty, and all the medals in the world won't protect you now.

mil_drone_operator.name: Military Drone Operator
mil_drone_operator.description: You realized the difference between what the army and the air force considers a 'drone operator' a bit too late.  Still, you have a couple manhacks to stand between you and the undead.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Chivalry! Daring! Honor! All traits that are useless in the Cataclysm. But you know how to fight with a sword and you have this armor so it could be worse.

airship_pilot.name: Airship Captain
airship_pilot.description: You once led a crew of skyfarers, traveling the skies for fame, bricks and sand.  Now you are on your own, and the ground is swarming with zombies.  At least this world has ground…

airboat_pilot.name: Airboat Commander
airboat_pilot.description: You were part of a squadron of skyfarers, plying the vastness to protect trade routes from nefarious air pirates.  Now you're adrift and alone, one vessel against an alien world swarming with the undead…

aircanoe_pilot.name: Aircanoe Pilot
aircanoe_pilot.description: You're a lone skyfarer, scouting the endless blue for new routes across the sky.  Now you've caught sight of more land than you've seen in a lifetime, an unfamiliar land of monsters…

tankmod_driver.name: Tank Driver
tankmod_driver.description: You were in charge of driving the tank, but without a commander it's a lot harder to get a clear picture of what's around you.

tankmod_gunner.name: Tank Gunner
tankmod_gunner.description: You were responsible for aiming and firing the main gun, but now you have no one left to spot targets for you.

tankmod_loader.name: Tank Loader
tankmod_loader.description: Your job was to help the main gunner with loading, now you'll have to do all the work yourself.

tankmod_commander.name: Tank Commander
tankmod_commander.description: Your role was to coordinate the tank crew's actions and spot targets, a job made significantly harder by everyone else being either dead or MIA.

irs.name: IRS-CI Special Agent
irs.description: After years of near-death encounters doing field work as a veteran special agent, nothing really fazes you anymore. You've been shot at, slashed at, swung on, and nearly run over while investigating tax fraud; this cataclysm is just a day in the life for you. With no one left to hold you accountable, taxes will be paid or capital punishment will be dispensed. You are inevitable.

elite_specops.name: Elite Operator
elite_specops.description: You were the best of the best, the military's finest, and among them you were better still.  Movies have been made about the missions you went on, and that's only the declassified ones. After getting back from yet another top secret mission, all you wanted to do was relax. Unfortunately, the Cataclysm had other plans, and now, stuck without your gear, you'll just have to show them what makes you tier one.

mall_ninja.name: Mall Ninja
mall_ninja.description: You knew the apocalypse was coming, and you bought all the high end weapons, armor, and gear the online forums said you would need to survive.  However, you never actually learned how to use any of it, and now that the Cataclysm is actually here, you're gonna have to figure it out quickly.

RNG_SURVIVOR.name: RANDOMISED: Melee survivor
RNG_SURVIVOR.description: You've looted a random assortment of intact armor and a pristine weapon from the overly hungry folk, but will it be enough?  (Note: What you see in character creation does not reflect what it will select at game start.)

mortician.name: Mortician
mortician.description: Before the Cataclysm, you used to embalm and bury bodies. Nowadays, there is no more room in hell, so you're putting them down instead.

evacuee.name: Evacuee
evacuee.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

missed.name: Missed
missed.description: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation, and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.

lakesurface.name: Pond Scum
lakesurface.description: Before the cataclysm, you spent your days exploring the local area's lakes and waterways.

surrounded.name: Surrounded
surrounded.description: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around and you'll likely have to fight thorough them if you want to escape.

isolationist.name: Safe Place
isolationist.description: You've found some distant safe place, devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own...

survivor_holdout.name: Survivor Holdout
survivor_holdout.description: A few days after fleeing the chaos of the cities, you've finally found a place still inhabited by the living.

infected.name: Infected
infected.description: In the chaos and panic of evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.

hunted_start.name: Challenge - Hunted
hunted_start.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.

fire.name: Burning Building
fire.description: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.

bad_day.name: Challenge - Really Bad Day
bad_day.description: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, and surrounded by fire.  This day went downhill really fast.

medieval.name: Challenge - Temporal Anomaly
medieval.description: A temporal distortion has hurled you into this collapsing world. You arrive carrying only the few items that mattered most to you - the things tied to who you are, or who you were meant to become.

player_feral.name: Challenge - The Lost And Damned
player_feral.description: You spent the first few weeks of the Cataclysm in a dull haze.  The riots have died down and the summer sun has drawn out the stench of decay.  You stagger out of your hiding place with a gnawing hunger, unsure if you're the only one left alive, or if this is what living death is like.

lab_chal.name: Challenge - Lab Patient
lab_chal.description: The scientists stopped their experiments on you abruptly, leaving you behind while they evacuated before lockdown.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.

lab_staff.name: Challenge - Lab Staff
lab_staff.description: You were deemed non-essential and made to stay behind during the lab evacuation.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.

bordered.name: Challenge - Bordered
bordered.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  The only thing that really bothers you is a mysterious sky-high wall seen in the distance.

ambushed.name: Ambush
ambushed.description: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay at, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.

summer_advanced_start.name: The Next Summer
summer_advanced_start.description: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.

alone.name: Sheltered
alone.description: When the apocalypse broke out, you were funneled into the nearest shelter.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the unknowns of the outside world hurt you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.

patient.name: Challenge - Abandoned
patient.description: Sickly and frail, you have spent years in the patient's ward of the hospital.  When yours was evacuated, you were left behind because you were a lost cause.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.

prisonbreak.name: Prison
prisonbreak.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the prisoners have turned into mindless horrors and the security bots are shooting on sight… you might need to expedite your escape plans.

alcatraz.name: Challenge - Island Prison
alcatraz.description: You were at a high-security prison right before the Cataclysm.  You managed to make it outside the inner walls…  Too bad it's located on a remote island, and now you need to find out how to escape it too.

migo_prisoner.name: Challenge - Mi-Go Camp
migo_prisoner.description: You find yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot humid air and the organic aspect of the structure makes you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.

mutant.name: Experiment
mutant.description: Since birth, your sole purpose in life has been the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you left the lab, and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.

foodplace.name: The Mascot Rises
foodplace.description: You just finished your shift and got back in the break room when you heard the alarms and the security door shutting down behind you.  There's a lot of customers out there and you're not sure Foodplace's delicious food™ is going to be enough for them.

last_delivery.name: The Last Delivery
last_delivery.description: While the world was falling apart someone called to order some of Foodplace's delicious food™ and they sent you to do the delivery.  You're not sure about much, but one thing is certain: that delicious food™ is going to get delivered even if that's the last thing you do!

wilderness.name: Wilderness
wilderness.description: You find yourself amongst trees.  The screaming and the moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.

heli_crash.name: Helicopter Crash
heli_crash.description: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  Hopefully some of the soldiers that were with you also survived the accident.

assassination.name: One Last Assassination
assassination.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding. Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.

Mine_bottom.name: Bottom of a Mine
Mine_bottom.description: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.

last_flight.name: Last Flight
last_flight.description: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  With no safe landing zones, knowing fuel will soon be a concern, you made a quick landing to plan your next move.

basement_dweller.name: Basement Dweller
basement_dweller.description: You were happiest tucked away below street level, tinkering and hiding in your basement.

cyberpunk.name: High Tech, Low Life
cyberpunk.description: Before the world ended, bionics were reserved for the rich and the famous.  You might not have been either, but you wanted in.  Hidden offices sequestered away in basements, anesthetic smuggled out of hospitals, and desperate people with little to lose could get you what you wanted.  If you went too deep, however, your augmentation may have come at a price...

overrun.name: Overrun
overrun.description: Despite all the soldiers, guns and minefields, the base you were on got overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and didn't make it there in time.  You are not sure if anyone made it to the armory, or if you are the last man alive.

presort.name: Crazy Party
presort.description: You thought things couldn't get any worse when the cops came over to bust your wild party, even though you booked it at a private resort.  When the guests started fighting with the police you tried to get them to calm down, only to find out they hungered for more.

aircraft_carrier_start.name: CVN Sailor
aircraft_carrier_start.description: For some reason your mission off the coast of North Korea has ended up stateside, stuck in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea what's happened, but now you have more important things to do.

tankmod_armored_warfare.name: Armored Apocalypse
