tankmod_armored_warfare.description: Wandering in search of any other survivors after a disastrous mobilization, your tank and its crew have slowly been worn down by attrition.  After trying to establish communications using an old radio tower, the only other surviving crew member went off in search of supplies and fuel a few days ago.  Now something's stirred up the undead, several are converging on your position.

irs_auditing.name: Death And Taxes
irs_auditing.description: Conducting an audit of a corporate office's records as part of a career-making official investigation, you found your hosts suddenly much less cooperative. It may be time to render summary judgment and haul ass out of this tower of toil.

lab_cargo_staff_1.name: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Concourse
lab_cargo_staff_1.description: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find a keycard before something finds you.

subway.name: The Metro
subway.description: In the chaos of the Cataclysm, you decided to make a run for the subway tunnels, hoping to find refuge away from the horrors on the surface.  Now, you find yourself in the dark tunnels of the subway system, and yet you feel like you're not alone...

nuclear_plant_start.name: Challenge - Emergency Shutdown
nuclear_plant_start.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from here fast before you find out the hard way.

ENCH_UNCANNY_DODGE_EFFECT.name: Uncanny Dodge
ENCH_UNCANNY_DODGE_EFFECT.description: You're currently under the effects of the Uncanny Dodge CBM.

MARTIAL_ARTS4.name: Venom Mob Protege
MARTIAL_ARTS4.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.

hair_ponytail.name: Hair style: ponytail
hair_ponytail.description: Hair done up in a ponytail

eye_red.name: Eye color: red
eye_red.description: You have incredibly rare red eyes.

eye_violet.name: Eye color: violet
eye_violet.description: You have incredibly rare violet eyes.

SKIN_DARK.name: Skin tone: dark brown
SKIN_DARK.description: You have a dark brown skin tone.

SKIN_LIGHTER.name: Skin tone: lighter
SKIN_LIGHTER.description: You have a lighter peach skin tone.

SKIN_LIGHT.name: Skin tone: light
SKIN_LIGHT.description: You have a light peach skin tone.

SKIN_MEDIUM.name: Skin tone: light brown
SKIN_MEDIUM.description: You have a light brown skin tone.

SKIN_PINK.name: Skin tone: rose
SKIN_PINK.description: You have a rosy pink skin tone.

SKIN_TAN.name: Skin tone: bronze
SKIN_TAN.description: You have a bronze or tan skin tone.

SKIN_OLIVE.name: Skin tone: olive
SKIN_OLIVE.description: You have an olive skin tone.

FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.name: Facial hair: none
FACIAL_HAIR_NONE.description: You have no hair on your face, it is shaven or simply untouched by the presence of hair.

FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.name: Facial hair: goatee
FACIAL_HAIR_GOATEE.description: You have a short beard at the tip of your chin.

FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.name: Facial hair: circle beard
FACIAL_HAIR_CIRCLE.description: You have a moustache and a short beard, that both form a circle around your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.name: Facial hair: royale beard
FACIAL_HAIR_ROYALE.description: You have a moustache and a short beard forming a patch under your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.name: Facial hair: anchor beard
FACIAL_HAIR_ANCHOR.description: You have a moustache and a beard starting with a strip going down from the bottom lip, then tracing the jaw lines.  It looks a bit like an anchor, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.name: Facial hair: short boxed beard
FACIAL_HAIR_SHORTBOXED.description: You have a moustache and a short beard with trimmed sides.  Thin patches connect them both, forming a 'box' around the lips, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.name: Facial hair: chevron moustache
FACIAL_HAIR_CHEVRON.description: You have a moustache that covers your entire top lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.name: Facial hair: 3-day stubble
FACIAL_HAIR_3DAYSTUBBLE.description: You have a short trimmed moustache and beard imitating a 3-day stubble.

FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.name: Facial hair: horseshoe
FACIAL_HAIR_HORSESHOE.description: You have a moustache with patches going down the chin from both ends, thus the name.

FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.name: Facial hair: original moustache
FACIAL_HAIR_MUSTACHE.description: You have a moustache with shortened ends, that covers only the skin above your upper lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.name: Facial hair: mutton chops beard
FACIAL_HAIR_MUTTONCHOPS.description: You have long sideburns that connect to your moustache, with the tip of the chin shaven clean.

FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.name: Facial hair: gunslinger beard
FACIAL_HAIR_GUNSLINGER.description: You have a horseshoe moustache and disconnected sideburns.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.name: Facial hair: chin strip
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRIP.description: You have a short beard in a form of a vertical patch under your bottom lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.name: Facial hair: chin curtain
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_CURTAIN.description: You have a full beard without a moustache, restricted to the chin, sometimes called a 'lion's mane'. Much like Abraham Lincoln's beard.

FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.name: Facial hair: chin strap
FACIAL_HAIR_CHIN_STRAP.description: You have a beard along the jaw lines, circling the chin, and no moustache.

FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.name: Facial hair: beard
FACIAL_HAIR_BEARD.description: You have a moustache and a long beard, both formed by allowing free growth of hair, with no particular styling.

FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.name: Facial hair: handlebar moustache
FACIAL_HAIR_HANDLEBAR.description: You have a moustache with long flared out ends.

FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.name: Facial hair: neckbeard
FACIAL_HAIR_NECKBEARD.description: You have a beard formed from hair grown on neck below the chin line.  No moustache included.

FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.name: Facial hair: pencil moustache
FACIAL_HAIR_PENCIL.description: You have a very thin moustache just above the line of the upper lip.

FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.name: Facial hair: shenandoah
FACIAL_HAIR_SHENANDOAH.description: You have a long full beard with no moustache, popular among Amish community, often with two pointed ends.

FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.name: Facial hair: sideburns
FACIAL_HAIR_SIDEBURNS.description: You have patches of hair in front of your ears, that normally would connect your hair with the beard, but they are here by themselves.

FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.name: Facial hair: soul patch
FACIAL_HAIR_SOUL_PATCH.description: You have a little bit of hair in the dip under your lower lip, and no other facial hair whatsoever.

FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.name: Facial hair: toothbrush moustache
FACIAL_HAIR_TOOTHBRUSH.description: Charlie Chaplin used to have this short patch of hair just under the nose, but then that other guy used it as a characteristic, and it became unwelcomed.

FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.name: Facial hair: Van Dyke
FACIAL_HAIR_VANDYKE.description: You have a handlebar moustache with a chin strip or a small goatee.

FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.name: Facial hair: walrus
FACIAL_HAIR_WALRUS.description: You have a long thick moustache, overshadowing your lips, that somewhat resembles the facial hair of a walrus.

FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.name: Facial hair: The Zappa
FACIAL_HAIR_ZAPPA.description: You have a wide soul patch and a full moustache that extends a bit downwards at the corners of your lips.

FACIAL_HAIR_WIZENED.name: Facial hair: wizened
FACIAL_HAIR_WIZENED.description: You have a long, flowing beard that indicates wisdom.

FACIAL_HAIR_JAW_SCRUFF.name: Facial hair: jaw scruff
FACIAL_HAIR_JAW_SCRUFF.description: You have wispy hair growing along your jawline.

FLEET.name: Fleet-Footed
FLEET.description: You can move more quickly than most, resulting in a 15% speed bonus on sure footing.

BIOLUM1.name: Weak Photophore
BIOLUM1.description: A photophore has grown under the skin of your cheeks; you can make them glow softly.  This will make you very visible in the dark, ideal for attracting a partner during mating season.

BIOLUM2.name: Photophore
BIOLUM2.description: You can make your photophore glow brightly.

GOODHEARING.name: Good Hearing
GOODHEARING.description: Your hearing is better than average, and you can hear distant sounds more easily.

FEYHEARING.name: Fey Hearing
FEYHEARING.description: You're not sure the shape of your ears is helping you any; regardless, you have become very sensitive to sounds.

INATTENTIVE.name: Inattentive
INATTENTIVE.description: You never paid attention to your surroundings and specifically to people around you.  You can't judge intent of critters you see.

OUTDOORSMAN.name: Outdoorsman
OUTDOORSMAN.description: You are accustomed to being exposed to the elements.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.

PARKOUR.name: Parkour Expert
PARKOUR.description: You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.  Your experience also allows you to take reduced damage from falls.

GOODCARDIO.name: Indefatigable
GOODCARDIO.description: Whether due to exercise and good diet, or due to a natural propensity to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much less readily than others.  Your maximum stamina and stamina regeneration is 25% higher than usual.

GOODCARDIO2.name: Hyperactive
GOODCARDIO2.description: Your body's efficiency is like that of a tiny furnace, increasing your maximum stamina and stamina regeneration by 40%.

QUICK.name: Quick
QUICK.description: You're just generally quick!  You get a 10% bonus to action points.

OPTIMISTIC.name: Optimist
OPTIMISTIC.description: Nothing gets you down!  You savor the joys of life, ignore its hardships, and are generally happier than most people.

FASTHEALER.name: Fast Healer
FASTHEALER.description: Your wounds heal themselves quicker than usual.  Sleep and medicine heal you 50% faster, and you even heal a little while awake.  Your broken limbs also heal less poorly without splints.

LIGHTEATER.name: Light Eater
LIGHTEATER.description: Your metabolism is a little slower, and you require less food than most.

EASYSLEEPER.name: Accomplished Sleeper
EASYSLEEPER.description: You have always been able to fall asleep easily, even when sleeping in less than ideal circumstances.

EASYSLEEPER2.name: Practiced Sleeper
EASYSLEEPER2.description: Your body's demanding energy needs mean you can fall asleep just about anywhere.

PAINRESIST.name: Pain Resistant
PAINRESIST.description: You have a high tolerance for pain.

NIGHTVISION.name: Night Vision
NIGHTVISION.description: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.

POISRESIST.name: Poison Resistant
POISRESIST.description: Your system is rather tolerant of poisons and toxins, and most will affect you less.

FASTREADER.name: Fast Reader
FASTREADER.description: You're a quick reader, and can get through books a lot faster than most.

BOVINE_BULK.name: Sheer Bulk
BOVINE_BULK.description: You've developed a very robust build.  You get a +15 bonus to all hit points.  Swimming will be more difficult from now on.

BOVINE_BULK2.name: Immense Bulk
BOVINE_BULK2.description: There is no way you'd be allowed to compete in pre-Cataclysm sports.  You get a +30 bonus to all hit points.  Swimming is no longer recommended for someone built like you.

TOUGH.name: Tough
TOUGH.description: It takes a lot to bring you down!  You get a 20% bonus to all hit points.

TOUGH2.name: Durable
TOUGH2.description: You can shrug off almost anything!  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.

TOUGH3.name: Unbreakable
TOUGH3.description: Nothing can break you!  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.

THICKSKIN.name: Thick-Skinned
THICKSKIN.description: Your skin is tough.  Armor is increased by 2 for your whole body.  There's a small chance you don't cut yourself on sharp terrain.

PACKMULE.name: Packmule
PACKMULE.description: You can manage to find space for anything!  You can carry 40% more volume.

STRONGBACK.name: Strong Back
STRONGBACK.description: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 35%.

FASTLEARNER.name: Fast Learner
FASTLEARNER.description: You have a flexible mind, allowing you to learn skills much faster than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

STRONGSTOMACH.name: Strong Stomach
STRONGSTOMACH.description: You are less likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up despite this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.

DEFT.name: Deft
DEFT.description: Your attacks are 10% faster overall.  You are also better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.

SPIRITUAL.name: Spiritual
SPIRITUAL.description: You've always felt that there is more to the world than we can see.  Whether driven by religious beliefs or philosophical interest, you find great inspiration in studying holy texts and experiencing mystical things.

TOLERANCE.name: Substance Tolerance
TOLERANCE.description: You can handle intoxicants well.  Their effects clear up more quickly for you.

GOURMAND.name: Gourmand
GOURMAND.description: You eat faster, and can eat and drink more, than anyone else!  You also enjoy food more; delicious food is better for your morale, and you don't mind unsavory meals as much.

LOVES_BOOKS.name: Bookworm
LOVES_BOOKS.description: There's nothing quite like the smell of a good book!  Books are more fun (or less boring) for you!

NONADDICTIVE.name: Addiction Resistant
NONADDICTIVE.description: Whether due to a lifetime of exposure or through simple willpower, it's harder for you to become addicted to substances, and easier to rid yourself of these addictions.

ANIMALEMPATH.name: Animal Empathy
ANIMALEMPATH.description: Peaceful animals will not run away from you, and even aggressive animals are less likely to attack.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

ANIMALEMPATH2.name: Animal Kinship
ANIMALEMPATH2.description: Something about your presence is calming to animals, and they will treat you with innate trust.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

TERRIFYING.name: Terrifying
TERRIFYING.description: There's something about you that creatures find frightening, and they are more likely to try to flee.

ADRENALINE.name: High Adrenaline
ADRENALINE.description: If you are in a very dangerous situation, you may experience a temporary rush which increases your speed and strength significantly.

WAKEFUL.name: Less Sleep
WAKEFUL.description: You need less sleep than the average person.

MASOCHIST.name: Masochist
MASOCHIST.description: Although you still suffer the negative effects of pain, it also brings a unique pleasure to you.

STIMBOOST.name: Stimulant Psychosis
STIMBOOST.description: You have a unique history with stimulants (like coffee or amphetamines).  You can tolerate a lot more of them without overdosing, but if you indulge too much, you start seeing things…

UNSTYLISH.name: Fashion Deficient
UNSTYLISH.description: You have no sense of style, and don't care about wearing anything 'fancy';  you'd be perfectly happy to wear non-matching socks, or wear socks and sandals.  You get no morale bonus from fancy equipment.

LIGHTSTEP.name: Light Step
LIGHTSTEP.description: You make no noise while walking.

EAGLEEYED.name: Scout
EAGLEEYED.description: You're an excellent navigator and your ability to recognize distant landmarks is unmatched.  Your sight radius on the overmap extends beyond the normal range, and distant details are easier for you to resolve.

UNOBSERVANT.name: Topographagnosia
UNOBSERVANT.description: Focal brain damage has rendered you incapable of recognizing landmarks and orienting yourself in your surroundings, severely crippling your sight radius on the overmap.

CANNIBAL.name: Cannibal
CANNIBAL.description: For your whole life you've been forbidden from indulging in your peculiar tastes.  Now the world's ended, and you'll be damned if anyone is going to tell you that you can't eat people.

PSYCHOPATH.name: Psychopath
PSYCHOPATH.description: You don't experience guilt like others do.  Even when you know your actions are wrong, you just don't care.

KILLER.name: Killer Drive
KILLER.description: You derive enjoyment from killing things.  Putting end to life seem to spark some dark satisfaction and thrill, and you crave it every moment.

MARTIAL_ARTS.name: Martial Arts Training
MARTIAL_ARTS.description: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, Kickboxing, or Pankration.

MARTIAL_ARTS2.name: Self-Defense Classes
MARTIAL_ARTS2.description: You have taken some self-defense classes at a nearby gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.

MARTIAL_ARTS3.name: Shaolin Adept
MARTIAL_ARTS3.description: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.

MARTIAL_ARTS5.name: Melee Weapon Training
MARTIAL_ARTS5.description: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pentjak Silat, or Sōjutsu.

MARTIAL_FENCING.name: Competitive Fencer
MARTIAL_FENCING.description: You were an avid fencer, starting with foil and moving onto saber, then épée.  You competed nationally and dabbled with some of the historical fencing weapons afforded by HEMA's popularity.

WEAKSCENT.name: Weak Scent
WEAKSCENT.description: Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.

LIAR.name: Skilled Liar
LIAR.description: You have no qualms about bending the truth, and have practically no tells.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much easier for you.

PRETTY.name: Pretty
PRETTY.description: You are a sight to behold.  People who care about such things will react more kindly to you.

BADKNEES.name: Bad Knees
BADKNEES.description: Whether due to injury or age, your knees aren't particularly strong or flexible.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down more than normal.

BADCARDIO.name: Languorous
BADCARDIO.description: Whether due to lack of exercise and poor diet, or due to a natural disinclination to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much more readily than others.  Your maximum stamina and stamina regeneration is 25% lower than usual.

MYOPIC.name: Near-Sighted
MYOPIC.description: Without glasses, your seeing radius is severely reduced!  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of glasses.

SLOWHEALER.name: Slow Healer
SLOWHEALER.description: Your wounds heal a little slower than most.  Your HP heals at 75% of the regular rate.

SLOWHEALER2.name: Poor Healer
SLOWHEALER2.description: Your health recovery is severely impaired.  Your HP heals at 33% of the regular rate.

SLOWHEALER3.name: Imperceptive Healer
SLOWHEALER3.description: Wounds are incredibly dangerous to you, as they barely heal at all.  Your HP heals at 10% of the regular rate.

HYPEROPIC.name: Far-Sighted
HYPEROPIC.description: Without reading glasses, you are unable to read anything, and take penalties on melee accuracy and electronics/tailoring crafting.  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of reading glasses.

HEAVYSLEEPER.name: Heavy Sleeper
HEAVYSLEEPER.description: You're quite the heavy sleeper.  Noises are unlikely to wake you up.

SLEEPY.name: Sleepy
SLEEPY.description: You need sleep more often, but still spend most of your time awake.

ASTHMA.name: Asthmatic
ASTHMA.description: You will occasionally need to use an inhaler, or else suffer severe physical limitations.  However, you are guaranteed to start with an inhaler.

BADBACK.name: Bad Back
BADBACK.description: You simply cannot carry as much as people with a similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is reduced by 35%.

BADTEMPER.name: Bad Temper
BADTEMPER.description: Things just keep getting you down.  You tend to be unhappy, and it takes some doing to cheer you up.

DISORGANIZED.name: Disorganized
DISORGANIZED.description: You are terrible at organizing and storing your possessions.  You can carry 40% less volume.

ILLITERATE.name: Illiterate
ILLITERATE.description: You never learned to read!  Books and computers are off-limits to you.

BADHEARING.name: Poor Hearing
BADHEARING.description: Your hearing is poor, and you may not hear quiet or far-off noises.

DEAF.name: Deaf
DEAF.description: You're not able to hear anything, and as such you're not able to talk to NPCs.

SLOWLEARNER.name: Slow Learner
SLOWLEARNER.description: You are slow to grasp new ideas, and thus learn things more slowly than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

INSOMNIA.name: Insomniac
INSOMNIA.description: You have a hard time falling asleep, even under the best circumstances!

VEGETARIAN.name: Meat Intolerance
VEGETARIAN.description: You have problems with eating meat.  It's possible for you to eat it, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from it.

THINSKIN.name: Thin-Skinned
THINSKIN.description: Your skin is fragile.  Physical armor is reduced by 2 across your whole body.

MEATARIAN.name: Hates Vegetables
MEATARIAN.description: You have problems with eating vegetables.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIFRUIT.name: Hates Fruit
ANTIFRUIT.description: You despise eating fruits.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

LACTOSE.name: Lactose Intolerance
LACTOSE.description: You, like 75 percent of the world, cannot tolerate milk or milk based products.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIJUNK.name: Junkfood Intolerance
ANTIJUNK.description: Something in those heavily processed foods doesn't agree with you.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

ANTIWHEAT.name: Grain Intolerance
ANTIWHEAT.description: You have a rare allergy that prevents you from eating most types of grains such as wheat or oats.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

PROJUNK.name: Sweet Tooth
PROJUNK.description: You have a soft spot for processed foods, and gain a morale bonus from eating them.

PROJUNK2.name: Sugar-Loving
PROJUNK2.description: You *adore* the taste of junk food, and find it preferable to everything else!

GLASSJAW.name: Glass Jaw
GLASSJAW.description: Your head can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 20% lower than usual.

LIGHTWEIGHT.name: Lightweight
LIGHTWEIGHT.description: Alcohol and drugs go straight to your head.  You suffer (and enjoy) the effects of these for longer.

ADDICTIVE.name: Addictive Personality
ADDICTIVE.description: It's easier for you to become addicted to substances, and harder to rid yourself of these addictions.

SMELLY.name: Strong Scent
SMELLY.description: Your scent is particularly strong.  It's not offensive to humans, but animals that track your scent will do so more easily.

CHEMIMBALANCE.name: Chemical Imbalance
CHEMIMBALANCE.description: You suffer from a minor chemical imbalance, whether mental or physical.  Minor changes to your internal chemistry will manifest themselves on occasion, such as hunger, sleepiness, narcotic effects, etc.

ANIMALDISCORD.name: Animal Discord
ANIMALDISCORD.description: Most animals don't like you, and aggressive animals are more likely to attack you.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

ANIMALDISCORD2.name: Prey Animal
ANIMALDISCORD2.description: Natural animals like dogs and wolves see you as prey, and are liable to attack you on sight.

SLOWREADER.name: Slow Reader
SLOWREADER.description: You're a slow reader, and it takes you longer to get through books than most.

SCHIZOPHRENIC.name: Psychosis
SCHIZOPHRENIC.description: You will periodically suffer from delusions, ranging from minor effects to full visual hallucinations.  Some of these effects may be controlled through the use of Thorazine.

NYCTOPHOBIA.name: Nyctophobia
NYCTOPHOBIA.description: You are terribly afraid of the dark.  You refuse to enter very dark areas.  If you somehow still happen to stay in dark areas, you suffer from various detrimental mental and physical effects.

CLAUSTROPHOBIA.name: Claustrophobia
CLAUSTROPHOBIA.description: Tight, enclosed spaces make your skin crawl.  Staying indoors drains your focus and gives you a steady morale penalty.

AGORAPHOBIA.name: Agoraphobia
AGORAPHOBIA.description: Open spaces and wide skies make you uneasy.  Spending time outdoors drains your focus and gives you a steady morale penalty.

CLUTTER_INTOLERANT.name: Clutter Intolerant
CLUTTER_INTOLERANT.description: Loose junk everywhere grates on your nerves.  Piles of items scattered on the ground nearby will steadily erode your morale.

NARCOLEPTIC.name: Narcoleptic
NARCOLEPTIC.description: You randomly fall asleep without any reason.

CLUMSY.name: Clumsy
CLUMSY.description: You make more noise while walking.

JITTERY.name: Jittery
JITTERY.description: When hungry or under the effects of stimulants, you may find your hands shaking uncontrollably, severely reducing your Dexterity.

HOARDER.name: Hoarder
HOARDER.description: You don't feel right unless you're carrying as much as you can.  You suffer morale penalties for carrying less than maximum volume (weight is ignored).  Xanax can help control this anxiety.

SAVANT.name: Savant
SAVANT.description: You tend to specialize in one skill and be poor at all others.  You advance at half speed in all skills except your best one.  Note that combining this with Fast Learner will come out to a slower rate of learning for all skills.

PACIFIST.name: Pacifist
PACIFIST.description: You don't like thinking about violence.  Your combat skills advance much slower than usual, and you feel more guilt about killing.

MOODSWINGS.name: Mood Swings
MOODSWINGS.description: Your morale will shift up and down at random, often dramatically.

SLOWRUNNER.name: Slow Footed
SLOWRUNNER.description: You can't move as fast as most, resulting in a 15% speed penalty on flat ground.

WEAKSTOMACH.name: Weak Stomach
WEAKSTOMACH.description: You are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.

WOOLALLERGY.name: Wool Allergy
WOOLALLERGY.description: You are badly allergic to wool, and cannot wear any clothing made of the substance.

UGLY.name: Ugly
UGLY.description: You're not much to look at.  People who care about such things will react poorly to you.

ALBINO.name: Albino
ALBINO.description: You lack skin pigmentation due to a genetic problem.  You sunburn extremely easily, and typically use an umbrella and sunglasses when going out in the sun.

FLIMSY.name: Flimsy
FLIMSY.description: Your body can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 25% lower than usual, and you heal slightly slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

FLIMSY2.name: Frail
FLIMSY2.description: Your body breaks very easily.  Its maximum HP is 50% lower than usual, and you heal slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

FLIMSY3.name: Fragile
FLIMSY3.description: Your body is extremely fragile.  Its maximum HP is 75% lower than usual, and you heal much slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

ROBUST.name: Robust Genetics
ROBUST.description: You have a very strong genetic base.  Mutations gained from eating mutant flesh will balance out at a higher number of positive mutations.

CHAOTIC_BAD.name: Genetic Downward Spiral
CHAOTIC_BAD.description: The events of the Cataclysm have damaged your DNA beyond repair.  You mutate frequently, and all mutations you receive (from any source) are negative.

SKIN_ROUGH.name: Rough Skin
SKIN_ROUGH.description: Your skin is slightly rough.  This has no gameplay effect.

NIGHTVISION2.name: High Night Vision
NIGHTVISION2.description: You can see incredibly well in the dark!

NIGHTVISION3.name: Full Night Vision
NIGHTVISION3.description: You can see in pitch blackness as if you were wearing night-vision goggles, and read in darkness as one can in dim lighting.

CEPH_EYES.name: Cephalopod Eyes
CEPH_EYES.description: Your eyes still bulge, yet your pupils look different somehow.  Water doesn't seem to cause any trouble at all, though.

ELFAEYES.name: Fey Eyes
ELFAEYES.description: Your eyes have turned… green.  It's tough to tell the exact shade as it seems to shift.  The effect is… pleasant.

FEL_EYE.name: Feline Eyes
FEL_EYE.description: Your eyes have mutated, now having a slitted pupil and glittering in light, much like those of cats.  This is visually striking, but it isn't helping you see at night.

BIRD_EYE.name: Avian Eyes
BIRD_EYE.description: Your vision has become particularly acute: you suspect you could pick out zombies much farther away.  Perception +4.

INFRARED.name: Infrared Vision
INFRARED.description: Your eyes have mutated to pick up radiation in the infrared spectrum.

LIZ_EYE.name: Reptilian Eyes
LIZ_EYE.description: Your eyes have mutated, with a brilliant iris and slitted pupil similar to that of a lizard.  This is visually striking, but doesn't seem to affect your vision.

LIZ_IR.name: Reptilian IR
LIZ_IR.description: Your optic nerves and brain have mutated to catch up with your eyes, allowing you to see in the infrared spectrum.

FASTHEALER2.name: Very Fast Healer
FASTHEALER2.description: Your flesh regenerates slowly.  You will regain HP at a moderate rate even when not sleeping, and sleep and medicine will heal you 50% more.

REGEN.name: Regeneration
REGEN.description: Your flesh regenerates from wounds incredibly quickly.  You constantly regenerate HP at a rapid rate, and sleep and medicine heal you 150% more.  You do not require splints to heal broken limbs.

REGEN_LIZ.name: Reptilian Healing
REGEN_LIZ.description: Your broken limbs mend themselves without significant difficulty.  You do not require splints.

WAKEFUL2.name: Very Little Sleep
WAKEFUL2.description: You don't sleep often.  But when you do, you need very little of it.

WAKEFUL3.name: Tireless
WAKEFUL3.description: You defend the realm all night and all day.

FANGS.name: Fangs
FANGS.description: Your teeth have grown into two-inch-long fangs, allowing you to make an extra attack when conditions favor it.

INCISORS.name: Incisors
INCISORS.description: Your big teeth have grown in.  Folks had best show some more respect.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite into %s with your large incisors

MEMBRANE.name: Nictitating Membrane
MEMBRANE.description: You have a set of clear lenses which lower over your eyes while underwater, allowing you to see as though you were wearing goggles.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

GILLS.name: Gills
GILLS.description: You've grown a set of gills in your neck, allowing you to breathe underwater.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

GILLS_CEPH.name: Cephalopod Gills
GILLS_CEPH.description: You've grown a set of gills, running from your neck up behind your ears.  They allow you to breathe underwater and slightly increase wet benefits.

M_SKIN.name: Mycus Flesh
M_SKIN.description: We have begun adapting local physiology to Mycus physical structure, greatly reducing wet effects and granting this vessel 1 cut and 2 bash armor.

M_SKIN2.name: Mycus Fireproofing
M_SKIN2.description: We have spliced the dense, amphibole fibers from Mycus core towers with the resilient, adaptive flesh of local physiology.  This reduces our speed by a moderate amount, but provides 2 cut 3 bash 1 bullet armor across our body, nullifies wet effects, and provides complete protection from fire.

M_SKIN3.name: Mycogenesis
M_SKIN3.description: Local physiology has been fully incorporated with that of Mycus silicate fibers.  In addition to benefits conferred by previous developments, as well as 3 cut 5 bash and 2 bullet armor, we may join with Mycus fibers beneath us - sleeping on top of fungal areas places us into a dormant state, which spreads spores around us as we sleep and revitalizes our body much more quickly than regular sleep.

SCALES.name: Scales
SCALES.description: A set of flexible green scales has grown to cover your body, acting as 3 points of natural armor across your body.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

THICK_SCALES.name: Thick Scales
THICK_SCALES.description: A set of heavy green scales has grown to cover your body, acting as 10 points of natural armor.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility, resulting in a -2 penalty to Dexterity.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

SLEEK_SCALES.name: Sleek Scales
SLEEK_SCALES.description: A set of very flexible and slick scales has grown to cover your body.  These act as 2 points of weak natural armor, improve your ability to swim, and make you difficult to grab.  Mostly reduces wet effects.

LIGHT_BONES.name: Light Bones
LIGHT_BONES.description: Your bones are very light.  This enables you to move and attack 10% faster, but also reduces your carrying weight by 20% and increases the damage you take from bashing attacks by 40%.

FEATHERS.name: Feathers
FEATHERS.description: Iridescent feathers have grown to cover your entire body, providing 3 points of armor against bash attacks and minor protection from cold.  They also provide a natural waterproofing.

DOWN.name: Down
DOWN.description: You shan't need to migrate south with your layer of down.  It's even better with no apes around to kill you for it!

LIGHTFUR.name: Lightly Furred
LIGHTFUR.description: Light fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing slight protection from cold.

FUR.name: Furry
FUR.description: Thick black fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing 3 points of armor against bashing attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

URSINE_FUR.name: Shaggy Fur
URSINE_FUR.description: Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing 5 points of armor against bashing attacks as well as considerable insulation.

LUPINE_FUR.name: Gray Fur
LUPINE_FUR.description: Dense gray fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing a 3 points of armor against bashing attacks, and considerable protection from cold.

FELINE_FUR.name: Sleek Fur
FELINE_FUR.description: You've grown sleek brown fur, providing some protection from cold.

LYNX_FUR.name: Lynx Fur
LYNX_FUR.description: Your fur has grown out significantly around your cheeks and neck.

PATCHSKIN1.name: Patchwork Skin
PATCHSKIN1.description: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of fur and scales, providing 2 points of armor across your entire body.

PATCHSKIN2.name: Thickened Patchwork Skin
PATCHSKIN2.description: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of thickened fur and scales, providing 5 points of armor across your entire body.

SUBDERMALARMOR.name: Keratinous subdermal layer
SUBDERMALARMOR.description: Your chaotic skin has wholly compressed all the different traits of animals into a thin, subdermal layer of armor. Not as good as fur for keeping you warm, but highly protective and you once more can blend in with the hairless apes. Though you are slightly heavier.

transform.msg_transform: Your skin morphs into a hideous armor of... Something!

CHIMERAARMOR.name: Chimera Shell
CHIMERAARMOR.description: Your subdermal armor has unfolded, providing a grotesque layer of protection against bullets, blades and human interaction. You shouldn't bother trying to do precise actions though, your hands are I'll suited for those things. Your metabolism has also massively accelerated, burning calories at a fast rate for increased regeneration speed.

transform.msg_transform: Your armor retracts, reverting you to your old, inferior look.

CHITIN.name: Chitinous Skin
CHITIN.description: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  It provides 5 points of protection from physical attacks.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

CHITIN2.name: Chitinous Armor
CHITIN2.description: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton, much like that of an insect.  It provides 8 points of armor across your entire body, but reduces your Dexterity by 1.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

CHITIN3.name: Chitinous Plate
CHITIN3.description: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton made of thick, stiff plates.  It provides 12 points of armor across your entire body, but reduces your Dexterity by 1 and encumbers all body parts but your eyes and mouth.  Greatly reduces wet effects.

CHITIN_FUR.name: Hairy Chitin
CHITIN_FUR.description: You've developed some sort of hair growing out of your chitin.  It's a bit warmer than not having hair, and provides 5 points of armor across your body.

CHITIN_FUR2.name: Furred Chitin
CHITIN_FUR2.description: Your chitin hair has thickened and spread across your body.  It provides 7 physical armor across your body, plus another 10 bash armor.

CHITIN_FUR3.name: Furred Plate
CHITIN_FUR3.description: Your exoskeleton has hardened considerably, providing 10 physical armor and 15 bash armor, imposing a further -1 to Dexterity, and boasts a fine coat of hairs that put feline whiskers to shame.

CF_HAIR.name: Urticating Hairs
CF_HAIR.description: Significant amounts of your hairs have loosened.  If some creature tries to attack you, your assailant is quite likely to get fine, bristly chitin in an irritating spot; it doesn't carry your venom but it will be distracting.

SPINES.name: Spines
SPINES.description: Your skin is covered with fine spines.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive moderate damage.

QUILLS.name: Quills
QUILLS.description: Your body is covered with large quills.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive significant damage.

BARBS.name: Assault barbs
BARBS.description: Some of the quills on your arms have become quite loose.  By flinging your arms, you can fire off these quills as projectiles.

ranged_mutation.message: You fire off some of your quills.

PLANTSKIN.name: Phelloderm
PLANTSKIN.description: Your skin is light green and has a slightly woody quality to it.  This provides 2 points of cut and stab armor and 1 point of ballistic armor, and helps you retain moisture, resulting in less thirst.  Greatly decreases wet penalties.

BARK.name: Bark
BARK.description: Your skin has grown over with bark, like that of a tree.  This provides an additional 3 points of cutting, piercing, and ballistic armor, along with 1 point of protection from fire.  Further reduces wet effects.

THORNS.name: Thorns
THORNS.description: Your skin is covered in small, woody thorns.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive minor damage.  Your punches may also deal extra damage.

LEAVES.name: Leaves
LEAVES.description: All the hair on your body has turned to long, grass-like leaves.  Apart from being physically striking, these provide you with a minor amount of nutrients while in sunlight when your head is uncovered.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

LEAVES2.name: Lush Leaves
LEAVES2.description: Your leaves have grown in size and prominence, with additional leaves sprouting along your arms.  While your arms and head are uncovered, you will photosynthesize nutrients while in sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.

LEAVES3.name: Verdant Leaves
LEAVES3.description: Your leaves are vibrant, large, and green, and have become a major source of nutrients for your body.  Whenever your arms and head are uncovered you will gain a large amount of nutrients by standing in the sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.

TRANSPIRATION.name: Transpiration
TRANSPIRATION.description: You body has begun moving nutrients via the evaporation of water.  This increases your thirst when it's hot, but reduces it when it's cold.

FLOWERS.name: Flowering
FLOWERS.description: You've started blooming where your scalp used to be.  Your blossoms have a pleasant aroma, are visually striking, and are quite sensitive.

ROSEBUDS.name: Rosebuds
ROSEBUDS.description: The top of your head is blooming with rosebuds.  They're eye catching, and have a strong fragrance that makes you pleasant to be around.

M_SPORES.name: Mycus Spores
M_SPORES.description: We have developed local spore sacs.  The Mycus must grow.

M_FERTILE.name: Mycus Sporogenesis
M_FERTILE.description: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local spore sacs remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.

M_BLOSSOMS.name: Mycus Blossoms
M_BLOSSOMS.description: We have developed local blossoms.  The Mycus must grow.

M_BLOOM.name: Mycus Bloom
M_BLOOM.description: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local blossoms remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.

M_PROVENANCE.name: Mycus Provenance
M_PROVENANCE.description: Local spore sacs and blossoms have merged into a single, symbiotic form.  Acting as one, they germinate together to cement rapid growth across a large area according to local guidance.  The Mycus must grow.

NAILS.name: Long Fingernails
NAILS.description: Your fingernails are long and sharp.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.

CLAWS.name: Claws
CLAWS.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  Prevents wearing gloves, unless they're fingerless.

CLAWS_RAT.name: Rat Claws
CLAWS_RAT.description: Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.  Prevents wearing gloves that aren't fingerless.

CLAWS_ST.name: Stainless Claws
CLAWS_ST.description: Your paws are bone, muscle, and claw with a thin layer of skin and fur.  They might as well be made of stainless steel.  Prevents wearing gloves that aren't fingerless.

CLAWS_RETRACT.name: Retractable Claws
CLAWS_RETRACT.description: You have claws on the ends of your fingers, and can extend or retract them as desired.  Gloves will still get in the way, though.

CLAWS_TENTACLE.name: Tentacle Rakes
CLAWS_TENTACLE.description: Your upper tentacles have grown large, hook-barbed rakes on the ends.  They're quite vicious, but really aren't suited for fine manipulation.

INK_GLANDS.name: Ink glands
INK_GLANDS.description: Several ink glands have grown onto your torso.  They can be used to spray defensive ink and blind an attacker in an emergency, as long as the torso isn't covered.

INSECT_RESERVOIR.name: Bulging Reservoir
INSECT_RESERVOIR.description: You develop a reservoir of fluids that bulges out of your abdomen.  Your body has adapted to containing extra liquids in event of shortfalls.

TALONS.name: Large Talons
TALONS.description: Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent wearing gloves, though fingerless gloves are fair game.

RADIOGENIC.name: Radiogenic
RADIOGENIC.description: Your system has adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will actually heal slowly, converting the radiation into hit points.

MARLOSS.name: Marloss Carrier
MARLOSS.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss berry, you can't get its scent out of your nose, and you have a strong desire to try some seeds and… sap?

MARLOSS_BLUE.name: Marloss Vessel
MARLOSS_BLUE.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss seed, you can't get its taste off of your tongue, and you have a strong desire to try some berries and… sap?

MARLOSS_YELLOW.name: Marloss Vector
MARLOSS_YELLOW.description: Ever since you ate that Marloss jelly, you can't stop thinking of it, and you have a strong desire to eat some seeds and berries.

MARLOSS_AVOID.name: Marloss Rejection
MARLOSS_AVOID.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to that Marloss junk, you can't bear the thought of ever eating it again!

MUTAGEN_AVOID.name: Mutagenic Aversion
MUTAGEN_AVOID.description: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to those mutagen and purifier things, you can't bear the thought of ever using them again!

PHEROMONE_INSECT.name: Insect Pheromones
PHEROMONE_INSECT.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of insects.  Insects will attack you much less.

PHEROMONE_MAMMAL.name: Mammal Pheromones
PHEROMONE_MAMMAL.description: Your body produces low-level pheromones which put mammals at ease.  They will be less likely to attack or flee from you.

INFRESIST.name: Infection Immune
INFRESIST.description: Your immune system is particularly good at resisting infections.  Your wounds will no longer become infected, altough existing infections are still dangerous.  You will also be able to install non-sterile CBMs.

M_IMMUNE.name: Mycus Identity
M_IMMUNE.description: We have synchronized our local physiology with that of the Mycus.  Any spores we may encounter will not attempt to germinate inside the local system, and we may traverse Mycus biospheres easily, as native bioforms shift shape to accommodate us.

PARAIMMUNE.name: Parasite Immune
PARAIMMUNE.description: Your body is unusually inhospitable to parasitic lifeforms.  You will never become infested with internal parasites.

POISONOUS.name: Venomous
POISONOUS.description: Your body produces a potent venom.  Cutting or stabbing attacks from mutations have a chance to poison your target.

POISONOUS2.name: Strongly Venomous
POISONOUS2.description: Your venom has become particularly strong.  You're confident that your bites or other cutting/stabbing natural attacks will take your target down quickly.

SLIME_HANDS.name: Slime Hands
SLIME_HANDS.description: The skin on your hands is a mucous membrane and produces a thick, acrid slime.  Attacks using your hand will cause minor cutting damage.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

BENDY1.name: Stretchy Limbs
BENDY1.description: Your limbs seem to have a little more 'give' to them.  +1 Dexterity.

BENDY2.name: Rubbery Limbs
BENDY2.description: Your limbs are significantly more flexible than any pathetic human arm or leg.  +3 Dexterity, -2 Strength.

BENDY3.name: Pseudolimbs
BENDY3.description: Your pseudopod-like limbs can fit into anything!  +4 Dexterity, -4 Strength.

COMPOUND_EYES.name: Compound Eyes
COMPOUND_EYES.description: Your eyes are compound, like those of an insect.  This increases your Perception by 2 whenever you aren't wearing eyewear.

PADDED_FEET.name: Padded Feet
PADDED_FEET.description: The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  If you're not wearing any shoes, you'll receive a 10% bonus to movement speed.

STRONG_LEGS.name: Strong Legs
STRONG_LEGS.description: Your legs have gained muscle mass to propel you across any terrain, and help carry a bit more.

RAP_TALONS.name: Toe Talons
RAP_TALONS.description: You have grown large, curved, and wickedly sharp talons in place of your big toes.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your movement.  Unfortunately, they do prevent wearing footgear.

HOOVES.name: Hooves
HOOVES.description: Your feet have fused into hooves.  This allows kicking attacks to do much more damage and provides 10 points of natural armor to your feet; however, you cannot wear shoes of any kind.  Reduces wet effects.

ALCMET.name: Alcohol Metabolism
ALCMET.description: So it's fermented?  Whatever, it's still good drinking.  You've developed the ability to metabolize alcohol as a food source.

PAINRESIST_TROGLO.name: Subterranean Fortitude
PAINRESIST_TROGLO.description: The aches and pains of living underground don't bother you as much.

STOCKY_TROGLO.name: Subterranean Build
STOCKY_TROGLO.description: Your frame has adapted for life in confined spaces.  You seem a little shorter and bulkier, trading mobility for muscle mass.  (+2 Strength, -2 Dexterity)

SAPROVORE.name: Saprovore
SAPROVORE.description: Your digestive system is specialized to allow you to consume decaying material.  You can eat rotten food, albeit for less nutrition than usual.

SAPROPHAGE.name: Saprophage
SAPROPHAGE.description: You prefer to sustain your nutritional needs using your roots and direct nutrient extraction/synthesis.  Your human parts still need the raw caloric bulk of 'food' to keep them going, though, and you handle it a lot easier if it's had time to… age a little.

GIZZARD.name: Gizzard
GIZZARD.description: You seem to get full faster now, and food goes through you more rapidly as well.

M_DEPENDENT.name: Mycus Feeder
M_DEPENDENT.description: We have streamlined our nutritional requirements.  We rely on the Mycus for sustenance, as it relies on us.  We may locate sources of sustenance in close proximity to Mycus core towers, and in forested areas that the Mycus has grown into.

RUMINANT.name: Ruminant
RUMINANT.description: Your digestive system is capable of digesting cellulose and other rough plant material.  You can eat underbrush and shrubs by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

GRAZER.name: Grazer
GRAZER.description: You're accustomed to eating plants directly, and can get nutrition from grass as well as underbrush and shrubs.  Eat either one by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.

EATDEAD.name: Eater Of The Dead
EATDEAD.description: Eating rotting, long-dead flesh is good for the struggle, and safe--if still completely unappealing--for you.

BURROW.name: Burrowing
BURROW.description: Your claws and teeth allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.

SABER_TEETH.name: Saber Teeth
SABER_TEETH.description: Your fangs have grown extremely large and incredibly sharp.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat… but leave nasty wounds when you bite.

attacks.attack_text_u: You tear into %s with your saber teeth
attacks.attack_text_npc: %1$s tears into %2$s with their saber teeth

EATHEALTH.name: Hyper-Metabolism
EATHEALTH.description: You metabolize nutrients so rapidly that you can convert food directly into useful tissue.  Excess nutrition will convert to HP, rather than being wasted. You can also store more kcal. Activate to skip prompt for overeating.

HORNS.name: Horns
HORNS.description: You have a pair of small horns on your head.  They allow you to make a weak piercing headbutt attack.

HORNS_CURLED.name: Curled Horns
HORNS_CURLED.description: You have a pair of large curled horns, like those of a ram.  They allow you to make a powerful bashing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing any headwear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You headbutt %s with your curled horns

HORNS_POINTED.name: Pointed Horns
HORNS_POINTED.description: You have a pair of long, pointed horns, like those of an antelope.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

attacks.attack_text_u: You stab %s with your pointed horns

ANTLERS.name: Antlers
ANTLERS.description: You have a huge rack of antlers, like those of a moose.  They allow you to make a weak headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

ANTENNAE.name: Antennae
ANTENNAE.description: You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.

FLEET2.name: Road-Runner
FLEET2.description: Your legs are extremely limber and fast-moving.  You move 30% faster on flat surfaces.

TAIL_STUB.name: Stubby Tail
TAIL_STUB.description: You have a short, stubby tail, like a rabbit's.  It serves no purpose.

TAIL_FIN.name: Tail Fin
TAIL_FIN.description: You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

TAIL_LONG.name: Long Tail
TAIL_LONG.description: You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_CATTLE.name: Cattle Tail
TAIL_CATTLE.description: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_RAT.name: Rodent Tail
TAIL_RAT.description: You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_THICK.name: Thick Tail
TAIL_THICK.description: You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_RAPTOR.name: Raptor Tail
TAIL_RAPTOR.description: You have a long and semi-stiff lizardlike tail.  You can't effectively lash it in combat, but it significantly improves your balance.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_FLUFFY.name: Fluffy Tail
TAIL_FLUFFY.description: You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge much higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_STING.name: Spiked Tail
TAIL_STING.description: You have a long tail that ends in a vicious stinger.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful piercing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

TAIL_CLUB.name: Club Tail
TAIL_CLUB.description: You have a long tail that ends in a heavy, bony club.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful bashing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

HIBERNATE.name: Hibernation
HIBERNATE.description: You've developed the ability to stockpile calories and then sleep for extended periods of time.

MUT_TOUGH.name: Resilient
MUT_TOUGH.description: You can survive injuries that would incapacitate humans: you get a 20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

PAINREC1.name: Pain Recovery
PAINREC1.description: You recover from pain slightly faster than normal.

MUT_TOUGH2.name: Solidly Built
MUT_TOUGH2.description: Not much scares you.  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

MUT_TOUGH3.name: TAAANK
MUT_TOUGH3.description: You can simply take the punishment from lesser beings and keep going.  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.

MASOCHIST_MED.name: Pain Junkie
MASOCHIST_MED.description: You've developed a serious appetite for pain, and take pride in your scars.

CENOBITE.name: Cenobite
CENOBITE.description: You positively adore pain, in all its varied forms.

NOPAIN.name: Deadened
NOPAIN.description: Nothing hurts anymore.  Those bites tickle and the wounds itch a bit, but that's it.

MORE_PAIN.name: Pain Sensitive
MORE_PAIN.description: For some reason, things always seem to hurt you more.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 25%.

MORE_PAIN2.name: Hyperalgesia
MORE_PAIN2.description: Your body experiences pain out of proportion to the physical causes.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 50%.

MORE_PAIN3.name: Extreme Hyperalgesia
MORE_PAIN3.description: Your body reacts cripplingly to any source of pain.  Pain dealt to you is doubled.

PRED1.name: Culler
PRED1.description: You've had a revelation: by killing the weaker creatures, who would only die anyway, you preserve resources for those better able to survive.  You are less bothered by the deaths of others: their own weakness invited these fates upon them.

PRED2.name: Hunter
PRED2.description: Your brain has a lot more in common with a predatory animal than a human, making it easier to control misplaced reactions to the death of your prey.  Additionally, combat skills, which you use to hunt, are easier to learn and maintain.

PRED3.name: Predator
PRED3.description: You consider yourself something other than human and no longer empathize with them.  Combat skills are easy to learn and maintain, but your critical thinking, so characteristic to these creatures, suffers.

PRED4.name: Apex Predator
PRED4.description: Your mind and brain have adapted to your new place in the world: as one on top of the food chain.  You can effortlessly master and maintain combat skills, but your critical thinking has atrophied further.

SAPIOVORE.name: Sapiovore
SAPIOVORE.description: The hairless apes make as good eating as any other meat.

M_DEFENDER.name: Mycus Defender
M_DEFENDER.description: From time to time the Mycus requires protection from non-Mycus that, for whatever reason, wish it ill.  We have adapted to better carry out this task - our fibers will grow strong and resilient when such threats present themselves to us.

WINGS_BIRD.name: Bird Wings
WINGS_BIRD.description: You have a pair of large, feathered wings.  Though your body is heavy and not built for sustained flight, you can use your wings to fly for short periods.  You can also glide to slow your descent and will never take falling damage under any circumstances.

WINGS_INSECT.name: Insect Wings
WINGS_INSECT.description: You have a pair of large, translucent wings.  They are too small to provide lift, but can reduce falling damage and if activated will greatly speed your movement, with some effort and noise.

MOUTH_TENTACLES.name: Mouth Tentacles
MOUTH_TENTACLES.description: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

MANDIBLES.name: Mandibles
MANDIBLES.description: A set of insect-like mandibles have grown around your mouth.  They allow you to eat faster and provide a slicing unarmed attack, but prevent wearing mouthwear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

FANGS_SPIDER.name: Folding Fangs
FANGS_SPIDER.description: Your mandibles have developed extensible fangs, allowing you to bite quickly or ensure your venom goes home, as desired.

CANINE_EARS.name: Canine Ears
CANINE_EARS.description: You've grown an extra pair of canine ears.  They enhance your hearing, allowing you to hear at greater distances.

LUPINE_EARS.name: Lupine Ears
LUPINE_EARS.description: Your hearing has evolved further and is now on par with that of wolves.  You can hear things significantly farther away.

FELINE_EARS.name: Feline Ears
FELINE_EARS.description: You've grown an extra pair of feline ears.  You find it easier to tune in on sounds from afar.  They are also very fluffy!

URSINE_EARS.name: Ursine Ears
URSINE_EARS.description: You've grown an extra pair of ursine ears.  You can hear things a little farther away.

ELFA_EARS.name: Pointed Ears
ELFA_EARS.description: Your upper earlobes have grown noticeably higher.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your headgear, much.  Unfortunately, they also don't seem to help your hearing any.

MOUSE_EARS.name: Rodent Ears
MOUSE_EARS.description: Your extra pair of ears are huge, round, and gray!  They're rather fascinating, and help you hear from a much greater distance.

WEB_WALKER.name: Web Walker
WEB_WALKER.description: Your body excretes very fine amounts of a chemical which prevents you from sticking to webs.  Walking through webs does not affect you at all.

WEB_SPINNER.name: Web Spinner
WEB_SPINNER.description: Your body produces and anchors webbing.  Too bad you can't seem to control the process.  There is a chance that you will leave webs in your wake.

WEB_WEAVER.name: Web Weaver
WEB_WEAVER.description: You've developed the necessary anatomy and techniques to control your web-generation.  Activate this to start or stop weaving webs.

WEB_RAPPEL.name: Web Diver
WEB_RAPPEL.description: Your webbing is easily strong enough to support your weight.  You'll use it to descend down any sheer drops you may encounter, and to catch yourself should you fall.

WEB_ROPE.name: Rope Webs
WEB_ROPE.description: With spinnerets like THESE, who needs rope?!  Activate to sling a web rope that you can climb, and can be disassembled into rope.

spawn_item.message: You spin a rope from your silk.

WEB_BRIDGE.name: Arachnitect
WEB_BRIDGE.description: The pinnacle of silk spinning.  Spin suspended walkways between ledges to span small gaps.

WHISKERS.name: Whiskers
WHISKERS.description: You have a handsome set of whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge very slightly, but only when uncovered.

WHISKERS_RAT.name: Wiry Whiskers
WHISKERS_RAT.description: You have a set of prominent rodent-like whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge slightly, but only when uncovered.

FAT.name: Fat Deposits
FAT.description: You've put on some additional weight around your body.  It slows you down a little, but helps your swimming and warmth and even provides 2 points of physical armor across your body.

LARGE.name: Inconveniently Large
LARGE.description: You have grown noticeably taller and broader.  Much of it is useful muscle mass (Strength +2), but you find it throws off your balance and you get in your own way (+10 torso, arm, and leg encumbrance).  You can also fire heavy weapons without the aid of terrain, at a penalty to accuracy. You gain 5% to all hit points with all the increased mass.

LARGE_OK.name: Large
LARGE_OK.description: You carry your rugged body with the dignity you deserve.  Strength +2, and you can fire heavy weapons without the aid of terrain at the cost of accuracy. You gain 10% to all hit points with all the increased mass because you're better at controlling how it soaks up damage.

HUGE.name: Freakishly Huge
HUGE.description: You have grown even more massive, to the point where you cannot usefully fit into human-sized clothing or vehicles.  Much of it is powerful muscle mass (Strength +4), but it's a real pain to haul around.  On the plus side, firing heavy weapons without mounting appropriate terrain is a bit easier. You gain 15% to all hit points with all the increased mass.

HUGE_OK.name: Huge
HUGE_OK.description: Your cardiovascular system has caught up with your muscular physique, so who needs pathetic human cars?  Strength +4, and you can fire heavy weapons unsupported more easily. You gain 20% to all hit points with all the increased mass because you're better at controlling how it soaks up damage.

STR_UP.name: Strong
STR_UP.description: Your muscles are a little stronger.  +1 Strength.

STR_UP_3.name: Extremely Strong
STR_UP_3.description: Your muscles are much stronger.  +4 Strength.

STR_UP_4.name: Insanely Strong
STR_UP_4.description: Your muscles are noticeably bulging.  +7 Strength.

DEX_UP.name: Dextrous
DEX_UP.description: You are a little nimbler.  +1 Dexterity.

DEX_UP_3.name: Extremely Dextrous
DEX_UP_3.description: You are nimble and quick.  +4 Dexterity.

DEX_UP_4.name: Insanely Dextrous
DEX_UP_4.description: You are much nimbler than before.  +7 Dexterity.

INT_UP.name: Smart
INT_UP.description: You are a little smarter.  +1 Intelligence.

INT_UP_3.name: Extremely Smart
INT_UP_3.description: You are much smarter, and your skull bulges slightly.  +4 Intelligence.

INT_UP_4.name: Insanely Smart
INT_UP_4.description: Your skull bulges noticeably due to your impressive brain.  +7 Intelligence.

INT_ALPHA.name: Prime Intelligence
INT_ALPHA.description: You understand almost everything about which you think, with minimal effort.

INT_SLIME.name: Distributed Neurology
INT_SLIME.description: Your brain has evolved beyond human imagination, though your body has become more vulnerable to bashing damage by -3 points of armor.  You'll show them the REAL meaning of 'gray goo'!

PER_UP.name: Perceptive
PER_UP.description: Your senses are a little keener.  +1 Perception.

PER_UP_3.name: Extremely Perceptive
PER_UP_3.description: Your senses are much keener.  +4 Perception.

PER_UP_4.name: Insanely Perceptive
PER_UP_4.description: You can sense things you never imagined.  +7 Perception.

PER_SLIME.name: Sensory Disintegration
PER_SLIME.description: Your sense organs are all over the place: eyes extending and retracting, 'ears' of various shapes migrating about, and taste & smell are uncontrollable.  The world is a horrible mixup.  Ugh!

PER_SLIME_OK.name: Distributed Senses
PER_SLIME_OK.description: You can now extend and reabsorb sensory organs at will, and can therefore ignore most shocks that would overwhelm lesser beings.

SMALL.name: Uncomfortably Small
SMALL.description: You've noticeably shrunk in size.  You're able to move with increased litheness, but your smaller stature prevents you from carrying as much.

SMALL_OK.name: Small
SMALL_OK.description: You can deny it no longer!  You are small.  You've adapted to your new size, suffering a bit less from your reduced carry capacity and increased fragility.

SMALL2.name: Worryingly Tiny
SMALL2.description: You're only half as tall as you used to be!  The weight of things you once found easy to carry is now unbearable, clothes are now twice as encumbering for you unless you refit them (since you're half their size), and your hit points are heavily reduced.  However, your movement is silent, and your dodge skill is a little higher.

SMALL2_OK.name: Tiny
SMALL2_OK.description: You've mastered your tiny form!  Item encumbrance and carry weight penalties are reduced, and you've learned to use your increased nimbleness to offset your reduced capacity to absorb damage.

CRAFTY.name: Crafty
CRAFTY.description: By making the most of your small stature, you can avoid the notice of all but the most perceptive creatures, and your speed is greatly increased.

MUT_JUNKIE.name: Metallassomaiphile
MUT_JUNKIE.description: Just thinking of mutagen (such a lovely word!  'Mutagen'.  Perfect!) makes you thirsty.  And you so love your new parts.  You simply must have more mutagen!

HEADBUMPS.name: Head Bumps
HEADBUMPS.description: You have a pair of bumps on your skull.

SLIT_NOSTRILS.name: Slit Nostrils
SLIT_NOSTRILS.description: You have a flattened nose and thin slits for nostrils, giving you a lizard-like appearance.  This makes breathing slightly difficult and increases mouth encumbrance by 10.

FORKED_TONGUE.name: Forked Tongue
FORKED_TONGUE.description: Your tongue is forked, like that of a reptile.  This has no effect.

EYEBULGE.name: Bulging Eyes
EYEBULGE.description: Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.

MOUTH_FLAPS.name: Mouth Flaps
MOUTH_FLAPS.description: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.

WINGS_STUB.name: Wing Stubs
WINGS_STUB.description: You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.

WINGS_BAT.name: Bat Wings
WINGS_BAT.description: You have a pair of large, leathery wings.  While you can fly short distances with them, it's more taxing than more aerodynamic wings would be.  They also hinder your balance, severely reducing your ability to dodge.

WINGS_BUTTERFLY.name: Butterfly Wings
WINGS_BUTTERFLY.description: You have a very large pair of brightly-colored, very beautiful wings that allow flight across short distances.  They make balancing tricky, making dodging much harder, but they certainly catch air and attention, and allow you to move faster overall.

SPOTS.name: Spots
SPOTS.description: Your skin is covered in a pattern of red spots.

SMELLY2.name: Smelly
SMELLY2.description: You smell awful.  Monsters that track scent will find you very easily, and humans will react poorly.

DEFORMED.name: Deformed
DEFORMED.description: You're slightly deformed.  Some people will react badly to your appearance.

DEFORMED2.name: Badly Deformed
DEFORMED2.description: You're hideously deformed.  Some people will have a strong negative reaction to your appearance.

DEFORMED3.name: Grotesque
DEFORMED3.description: Your visage is disgusting and liable to induce vomiting.  People will not want to interact with you unless they have a very good reason to.

BEAUTIFUL.name: Beautiful
BEAUTIFUL.description: You're a real head-turner.  Some people will react well to your appearance, and most people have an easier time trusting you.

BEAUTIFUL2.name: Very Beautiful
BEAUTIFUL2.description: You are a vision of beauty.  Some people will react very well to your looks, and most people will trust you immediately.

BEAUTIFUL3.name: Glorious
BEAUTIFUL3.description: You are incredibly beautiful.  People cannot help themselves due to your charms, and will do whatever they can to please you.

SNOUT.name: Snout
SNOUT.description: Your face and jaw have begun… changing.  Masks and such fit OK, but you're noticeably mutated.

MINOTAUR.name: Bovine Snout
MINOTAUR.description: Your face resembles that of a bull, with a significant snout.  It looks fearsome but prevents wearing mouthgear.

MUZZLE.name: Lupine Muzzle
MUZZLE.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a wolfish muzzle.  It lends itself to biting in combat and looks impressive, but prevents wearing mouthgear.

MUZZLE_BEAR.name: Ursine Muzzle
MUZZLE_BEAR.description: Your jaw and nose have extended into a bearish muzzle.  You could bite with it, and it looks impressive, but it prevents wearing mouthgear.

MUZZLE_RAT.name: Rodent Muzzle
MUZZLE_RAT.description: Your face and jaw have extended, giving you an alert and attentive appearance.

MUZZLE_LONG.name: Reptilian Muzzle
MUZZLE_LONG.description: Your face and jaws are a shorter version of those found on alligators.  They look NASTY--as do the bite wounds they can inflict--but prevent wearing mouthgear.

attacks.attack_text_u: You bite a chunk out of %s

PROBOSCIS.name: Proboscis
PROBOSCIS.description: You've gotten rid of that terribly imprecise mouth and now imbibe your food like a proper person.  Chewing was tiresome anyway.

HOLLOW_BONES.name: Hollow Bones
HOLLOW_BONES.description: You have Avian Bone Syndrome--your bones are nearly hollow.  Your body is very light as a result, enabling you to move and attack 20% faster, but also frail; you can carry 40% less, and take 80% more damage from bashing attacks.

NAUSEA.name: Nausea
NAUSEA.description: You feel nauseated almost constantly, and are more liable to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  You can, if desired, think yourself into vomiting, too.

VOMITOUS.name: Vomitous
VOMITOUS.description: You have a major digestive disorder.  Though it causes you to vomit frequently, you have found that you can trigger your vomit reflex on demand, too.

PERSISTENCE_HUNTER.name: Persistence Hunter
PERSISTENCE_HUNTER.description: You can pursue prey for miles and miles at a variety of paces until they stop from exhaustion.

PERSISTENCE_HUNTER2.name: Extreme Persistence Hunter
PERSISTENCE_HUNTER2.description: You can pursue prey for days until they literally die from exhaustion.  It's too bad zombies don't fatigue either.

HUNGER.name: Fast Metabolism
HUNGER.description: You require more food than most people.  On a plus side, you are more resistant to cold.

BODYHAIR.name: Hairy
BODYHAIR.description: Your body is covered in thick body hair, making you slightly warmer.

MET_RAT.name: Rapid Metabolism
MET_RAT.description: You require more food and sleep than most, but heal more rapidly as well.  Provides weak regeneration even when not asleep.

HUNGER2.name: Very Fast Metabolism
HUNGER2.description: You need about twice as much food as the average human to maintain your flawed biology.  At least it warms you up when you need it.

HUNGER3.name: Extreme Metabolism
HUNGER3.description: You consume three times as much food as the average human to maintain your inefficient body.  All the excess heat it generates could let you survive a snowstorm naked.

THIRST.name: High Thirst
THIRST.description: Your body dries out easily; you need to drink more water.

THIRST2.name: Very Thirsty
THIRST2.description: Ugh, out of water already?  You need about twice the fluids of an average human.

THIRST3.name: Extremely Thirsty
THIRST3.description: You dry out seriously quickly, requiring three times as much liquid to stay hydrated.

NO_THIRST.name: Metabolic Rehydration
NO_THIRST.description: Your body gets everything it needs from the food that you eat!  You no longer need hydration from fluids.

HEAVYSLEEPER2.name: Very Heavy Sleeper
HEAVYSLEEPER2.description: You could probably sleep through a firefight.

SLEEPY2.name: Very Sleepy
SLEEPY2.description: You find yourself needing to sleep quite often.  You'll spend about half of your time in or around a bed.

ROT1.name: Weakening
ROT1.description: You feel as though you are slowly weakening and your body heals slower.

ROT2.name: Deterioration
ROT2.description: Your body is slowly wasting away, and your wounds heal noticeably slower.

ROT3.name: Disintegration
ROT3.description: Your body is wasting away! You need good medical care, and you need it more often.

SUNBURN.name: Solar Sensitivity
SUNBURN.description: Your skin simply cannot handle ultraviolet radiation, such as sunlight.  It will seriously burn you.

SORES.name: Sores
SORES.description: Your extremities are covered in painful sores.  The pain is worse when they are covered in clothing.

TROGLO.name: Light Sensitive
TROGLO.description: Sunlight makes you uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors and the weather is Sunny, you suffer -1 to all stats.

TROGLO2.name: Very Light Sensitive
TROGLO2.description: Sunlight makes you very uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors during the day, you suffer -1 to all stats; -2 if the weather is Sunny.

TROGLO3.name: Troglobite
TROGLO3.description: Sunlight makes you extremely uncomfortable, resulting in large penalties to all stats.

WEBBED.name: Webbed Hands
WEBBED.description: Your hands and feet are heavily webbed, reducing your Dexterity by 1 and causing problems with gloves.  However, you can swim much faster.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.

PAWS.name: Paws
PAWS.description: Your hands have fused into quasi-paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better.

PAWS_LARGE.name: Broad Paws
PAWS_LARGE.description: Your paws are much larger now.  Manual dexterity is difficult: permanent hand encumbrance of 20, serious problems crafting, and no gloves.  In return, though, you can swim better.

BEAK.name: Beak
BEAK.description: You have a beak for a mouth.  You can occasionally use it to peck at your enemies, but it is impossible for you to wear mouth gear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

BEAK_PECK.name: Woodpecker Beak
BEAK_PECK.description: Pecking at prey is part of your daily routine now.  Slightly reduces wet effects.

attacks.attack_text_u: You jackhammer into %s with your beak

BEAK_HUM.name: Hummingbird Beak
BEAK_HUM.description: Though your beak's not suitable for pecking, those flowers out there are a good source of energy.  Examine them to feed.

UNSTABLE.name: Genetically Unstable
UNSTABLE.description: Your DNA has been damaged in a way that causes you to continually develop more mutations.

CHAOTIC.name: Genetic Chaos
CHAOTIC.description: Your body alters itself rapidly, and without your intervention or conscious control.

RADIOACTIVE1.name: Minor Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE1.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit low levels of radiation, which slowly contaminates the world around you.

RADIOACTIVE2.name: Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE2.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit moderate levels of radiation, which contaminates the world around you.  You also produce a lot of heat.

RADIOACTIVE3.name: Severe Radioactivity
RADIOACTIVE3.description: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit heavy levels of radiation, making your surroundings unlivable.  You also overheat fast.

SLIMY.name: Slimy
SLIMY.description: Your body is coated with a fine slime.  Protects from long-term effects of acid, though not short-term ones. It also protects from other sources of slime.  Greatly increases wet benefits.

VISCOUS.name: Viscous
VISCOUS.description: Your body's slime output has become sticky and gel-like.  Provides 2 points of acid protection.  Greatly increases wet benefits.

AMORPHOUS.name: Amorphous Body
AMORPHOUS.description: Your flesh is a pleasing gel-like consistency, providing 4 points of bash armor all over.  Your bodily functions seem to be moving around, and your leg-equivalents flow comfortably - if a little slower than your old meat-legs.

SLIMESPAWNER.name: Omnicellular
SLIMESPAWNER.description: Your body is more or less one consistent whole: a single, giant, omni-cell that alters itself as needed.

HERBIVORE.name: Herbivore
HERBIVORE.description: Your body's ability to digest meat is severely hampered.  Eating meat has a good chance of making you vomit it back up; even if you manage to keep it down, its nutritional value is greatly reduced.

CARNIVORE.name: Carnivore
CARNIVORE.description: Your body's ability to digest fruits, vegetables, grains and nuts is severely hampered.  You cannot eat anything besides meat.

PONDEROUS1.name: Ponderous
PONDEROUS1.description: Your muscles are generally slow to move.  You move 10% slower.

PONDEROUS2.name: Very Ponderous
PONDEROUS2.description: Your muscles are quite slow to move.  You move 20% slower.

PONDEROUS3.name: Extremely Ponderous
PONDEROUS3.description: Your muscles are very slow to move.  You move 30% slower.

SUNLIGHT_DEPENDENT.name: Sunlight Dependent
SUNLIGHT_DEPENDENT.description: You feel very sluggish when not in direct sunlight.  You suffer a 5% drop in speed when in shade, and a 10% drop in speed when in the dark.

VINES1.name: Vines
VINES1.description: You have developed several vines sprouting from your shoulder area.  They're bulky, and get in the way.

VINES2.name: Vine Limbs
VINES2.description: You've developed the ability to control your vines; they make good lashes.  You can even rappel down sheer drops using them, but disconnecting HURTS.

VINES3.name: Vine Sprouter
VINES3.description: You have full control of your vines, and can grow new ones and detach old ones more or less at will.

spawn_item.message: You detach a vine from your body.

HAIRROOTS.name: Hair Roots
HAIRROOTS.description: Roots have started growing from your leaf-like hair.  They don't seem to do much.

ROOTS1.name: Toe Roots
ROOTS1.description: Your toes have grown wriggly, and you can't imagine why you wear that stuff on your feet.  Take it off.  It's in the way.

ROOTS2.name: Roots
ROOTS2.description: It's about time you started developing a root system.  When reading, fishing, waiting, or otherwise being stationary for a while on diggable terrain, you'll extract nutrients and water from the soil.

ROOTS3.name: Rooter
ROOTS3.description: You find it difficult not to sink roots when able.  You extract nutrients and water whenever on diggable terrain, but move more slowly.

CHLOROMORPH.name: Chloromorphosis
CHLOROMORPH.description: Every inch of your skin is packed with chlorophyll and you have strong roots.  Sleeping on diggable soil will satisfy any hunger or thirst you might have.

TREE_COMMUNION.name: Mycorrhizal Communion
TREE_COMMUNION.description: You have gained the ability to commune with trees and comprehend their ancient wisdom.  Activate next to a tree to gradually gain overmap vision through connected forests.

COLDBLOOD.name: Heat Dependent
