COLDBLOOD.description: Your muscle response is dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 5 (2.8) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C).  This sluggishness helps you conserve energy, however.

COLDBLOOD2.name: Very Heat Dependent
COLDBLOOD2.description: Your muscle response is highly dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 3 (1.7) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), but your slow metabolism requires much less food.

COLDBLOOD3.name: Cold Blooded
COLDBLOOD3.description: You are cold-blooded and rely on heat to keep moving.  Your lose 1% of your speed for every 2 (1.1) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), but only need to eat about half as much as before.

COLDBLOOD4.name: Ectothermic
COLDBLOOD4.description: Your body has become permanently cold-blooded.  Your speed lowers or raises 1% for every 2 (1.1) degrees below or above 65 F (18.3 C).  You only need to eat half as much as an average human.

GROWL.name: Growling Voice
GROWL.description: You have a growling, rough voice.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.

SNARL.name: Snarling Voice
SNARL.description: You have a threatening snarl in your voice.  Persuading NPCs will be near impossible, but threatening them will be much easier.

HISS.name: Hissing Voice
HISS.description: You hiss when speaking.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.

SHOUT3.name: Howler
SHOUT3.description: You frequently let out a piercing howl.

ARM_FEATHERS.name: Feathered Arms
ARM_FEATHERS.description: Your arms have grown vibrantly-colored feathers.  They effectively waterproof your arms and provide 1 point of bashing armor, but really get in the way.  They're simply too small to help you in the air.

INSECT_ARMS.name: Insect Limbs
INSECT_ARMS.description: You've *finally* sprouted a pair of arms from your midsection.  They flail more or less uncontrollably, making you feel rather larval.

INSECT_ARMS_OK.name: Insect Arms
INSECT_ARMS_OK.description: It's good having all your arms.  Though they're too thin to block or punch, you can fold them inside human-shaped gear if need be.

ARACHNID_ARMS.name: Arachnid Limbs
ARACHNID_ARMS.description: There's the last two limbs you were expecting.  Unfortunately, you still can't coordinate them, so you're getting in your own way.  A lot.

ARACHNID_ARMS_OK.name: Arachnid Arms
ARACHNID_ARMS_OK.description: You have four handsome limbs, and then those mutant 'hand' and 'foot' things.  They probably aren't worth concealing.

ARM_TENTACLES.name: Tentacle Arms
ARM_TENTACLES.description: Your arms have transformed into tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

ARM_TENTACLES_4.name: 4 Tentacles
ARM_TENTACLES_4.description: Your arms have transformed into four tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 3 extra attacks with them.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

ARM_TENTACLES_8.name: 8 Tentacles
ARM_TENTACLES_8.description: Your arms have transformed into eight tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 7 extra attacks with them.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.

SHELL.name: Shell
SHELL.description: You have grown a thick shell over your torso, providing 6 bash, 14 cut, and 5 bullet armor.  You find you can use the empty space as 16 storage space, but cannot wear anything on your torso.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.

SHELL2.name: Roomy Shell
SHELL2.description: Your protective shell has grown large enough to accommodate--if need be--your whole body, providing 9 bash, 17 cut, and 5 bullet armor.  Activate to pull your head and limbs into your shell, trading mobility and vision for warmth and shelter.

LEG_TENTACLES.name: Leg Tentacles
LEG_TENTACLES.description: Your legs have transformed into six tentacles.  This decreases your speed on land by 20%, makes your movement silent, increases your swimming speed and reduces wet penalties, but you can't use footwear any more.

LEG_TENT_BRACE.name: Tentacle Bracing
LEG_TENT_BRACE.description: Your lower tentacles have developed suckers.  They make land movement marginally more tiring, but do a good job of keeping you set in place.

THRESH_LIZARD.name: Lizard
THRESH_LIZARD.description: You sometimes look back on your days before your tail came in.  But you're better now.

THRESH_SERPENT.name: Serpent
THRESH_SERPENT.description: They say you have to crawl before you can walk.  You walked, but now slithering feels better.

THRESH_BIRD.name: Bird
THRESH_BIRD.description: The skies are your domain now.  And the land too, there are still nests to build after all.

THRESH_FISH.name: Aquatic
THRESH_FISH.description: Ninety percent of the planet, and it's yours to explore.  And colonize.  And enjoy.  What was that about a surface?

THRESH_BEAST.name: Beast
THRESH_BEAST.description: It's about time you grew out.  Now that you've matured, it is time to make something of yourself.

THRESH_FELINE.name: Feline
THRESH_FELINE.description: Stalking prey, eating well, and lying in the sun.  Mmm, all you could ever desire.

THRESH_LUPINE.name: Wolf
THRESH_LUPINE.description: You're the perfect candidate to lead a pack.

THRESH_URSINE.name: Bear
THRESH_URSINE.description: So the humans died; what's the worry?  Now they won't ruin the woods.

THRESH_CATTLE.name: Bovine
THRESH_CATTLE.description: Civilization collapsed?  Great!  You and your kin will never have to worry about a slaughterhouse again.

THRESH_INSECT.name: Insect
THRESH_INSECT.description: It would be good to be a Queen, having workers constantly servicing your every need… but how would you keep them in line?

THRESH_PLANT.name: Plant
THRESH_PLANT.description: Well, you still have those other walking flowers-and the mushrooms too-to deal with.  But you'll manage.

THRESH_SLIME.name: Aqueous
THRESH_SLIME.description: What was that old advertisement?  'Paint the planet'?  That might be a good long-term goal, but for now…

THRESH_TROGLOBITE.name: Subterranean
THRESH_TROGLOBITE.description: Not much point to rebuilding up in that horribly bright roofless wasteland.  Now that you've become accustomed to your new digs, there's the beginning of a great empire right here, underground.

THRESH_CEPHALOPOD.name: Cephalopod
THRESH_CEPHALOPOD.description: Strange aeons, true, but Death seems to be slacking, and you are doing just fine.

THRESH_SPIDER.name: Arachnid
THRESH_SPIDER.description: Well, maybe you'll just have to make your own worldwide web.

THRESH_RAT.name: Survivor
THRESH_RAT.description: Hey.  Civilization fell.  You're still around.  'Rat' just isn't respectful.

THRESH_MEDICAL.name: Prototype
THRESH_MEDICAL.description: After all those experiments, what's a few more, hmm?

THRESH_ALPHA.name: Prime
THRESH_ALPHA.description: You're the perfect candidate to tidy this mess.

THRESH_ELFA.name: Fey
THRESH_ELFA.description: You are the tree under which humankind will shelter during these dark times.

THRESH_CHIMERA.name: Chaos
THRESH_CHIMERA.description: You can't tell what you are anymore.  Everything and yet nothing, like you weren't meant to exist.  But you do, and you're a force, no matter what happens.

THRESH_RAPTOR.name: Raptor
THRESH_RAPTOR.description: The chance to undo not one but TWO extinction events.  You're confident you'll do fine.

THRESH_MOUSE.name: Diminutive
THRESH_MOUSE.description: So much food, everywhere!  And nobody's even guarding it anymore!  These are good times.

THRESH_RABBIT.name: Lagomorph
THRESH_RABBIT.description: You really want to eat some carrots.  Welcome to the Lagomorpha family.

RABBIT_EARS.name: Rabbit Ears
RABBIT_EARS.description: Your ears have grown into tall, flexible and pretty rabbit ears.  They're are slender and enhance your hearing beyond the normal range.

TAIL_RABBIT.name: Rabbit Tail
TAIL_RABBIT.description: Your stubby tail has become fuzzy and more round.  It looks adorable, but doesn't seem to serve another purpose beyond that.

RABBIT_FUR.name: Rabbit Fur
RABBIT_FUR.description: Your fur keeps you covered in winter, providing 1 point of bash armor across most of your body and maintaining heat and allowing you to better tolerate cold temperatures.

RABBIT_FEET.name: Rabbit Feet
RABBIT_FEET.description: Your feet have grown into strong and large rabbit feet.  This makes your kicks pack a little more oomph, and gives your feet 1 bashing armor.  Emphasis on little.  It also offers some warmth, and the lucky part is but superstition.  The downside is you are unable to wear shoes.

attacks.attack_text_u: You kick %s with your large feet

RABBIT_NOSE.name: Rabbit Nose
RABBIT_NOSE.description: Your nose has morphed into a cute bunny nose, along with the snout.  It's extremely twitchy too.

PAWS_LITTLE.name: Little Paws
PAWS_LITTLE.description: Your hands have elongated and look a bit more like paws.  It makes fine manipulation a little more difficult, but you can still probably manage.

THRESH_MARLOSS.name: Marloss Gateway
THRESH_MARLOSS.description: You get the feeling that you're on the cusp of becoming something greater than yourself.

ACIDPROOF.name: Acidproof
ACIDPROOF.description: Your mutated flesh is immune to the damaging effects of acid.

ACIDBLOOD.name: Acid Blood
ACIDBLOOD.description: Your body has developed a wonderful defense mechanism.  Instead of normal blood, you bleed a strong molecular acid which will damage any creature foolish enough to harm you.

PYROMANIA.name: Pyromaniac
PYROMANIA.description: You have an unhealthy obsession with fire, and you get anxious if you don't light them every now and then or stand near them often.  However, you gain a mood bonus from doing so.

AMPHIBIAN.name: Amphibious
AMPHIBIAN.description: You're as comfortable in water as on land, and your body has adapted around that fact.  Your base swimming speed is greatly increased, and weight will hinder you much less while swimming.

SEESLEEP.name: Lidless Eyes
SEESLEEP.description: Like a true fish, your eyes lack eyelids, and are instead covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water, and provides 3 cut and 1 bash armor.  It also allows you to sleep with your eyes open!  Activate to cause the approach of hostile creatures to wake you up.

WATERSLEEP.name: Aqueous Repose
WATERSLEEP.description: Falling asleep underwater is easy for you, and you spend less time asleep when you rest there.  You can also eat underwater, though you can't drink.

TOXICFLESH.name: Toxic Flesh
TOXICFLESH.description: Your flesh is highly poisonous, and creatures that bite you will receive a nasty surprise.

FRESHWATEROSMOSIS.name: Freshwater Osmosis
FRESHWATEROSMOSIS.description: Your gills and skin are highly permeable to moisture, and you can hydrate your body through osmosis.  While submerged in fresh water, any thirst you might have will be slaked.

ELECTRORECEPTORS.name: Electroreceptors
ELECTRORECEPTORS.description: A network of jelly-filled electroreceptors, like that of a shark, have grown throughout your face and nose.  They are very sensitive to magnetic fields, allowing you to see robots and creatures charged with electricity through walls, but being shocked will seriously mess you up.

SHARKTEETH.name: Shark Teeth
SHARKTEETH.description: Your teeth have grown incredibly sharp, and have calcified even further.  In addition to letting you eat much faster, you can use them as a lethal natural weapon, as long as your anatomy favors it.  They also grow very fast, and you harmlessly shed them more or less at random.

attacks.attack_text_u: You tear into %s with your teeth

TAIL_SNAKE.name: Snake Body
TAIL_SNAKE.description: Your legs and feet have merged into a long, scaly tail.  It's harder for you to move (though you can wind through obstacles a bit better) and harder to dodge, and limits what you can wear.  Anything you can get to fit on your tail just makes crawling around even more awkward.  At least it protects your lower half decently, reduces wet effects, and lets you carry more weight.

TAIL_SNAKE_OK.name: Serpentine Body
TAIL_SNAKE_OK.description: Your snake body has grown stronger and more flexible, or maybe you're just getting used to moving with it.  It's still incredibly inconvenient to find clothes for your tail, but you're better at navigating obstacles and can even whip enemies with the end.

SNAKE_COILS.name: Crushing Coils
SNAKE_COILS.description: Your newfound size has granted some extra bulk to your serpentine half.  You haven't figured out how to constrict anything with it, but it does further enhance your strength (+4) and your lower half's natural armor is even thicker.

PROF_POLICE.name: Police Officer
PROF_POLICE.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether that means anything now is another question.

PROF_SWAT.name: SWAT Officer
PROF_SWAT.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether that means anything now is another question.

PROF_CYBERCOP.name: Bionic Officer
PROF_CYBERCOP.description: You are a cybernetically-resurrected law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether you can do for the law what the law did for you is another question.

PROF_CHURL.name: Churl
PROF_CHURL.description: Thou art a lewede man, a lowly cowherd, though where thi catel been thou hast not ynn certain.

PROF_PD_DET.name: Police Detective
PROF_PD_DET.description: You are a duly sworn law enforcement investigator, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether your shield means anything now is another question.

PROF_FED.name: US Marshal
PROF_FED.description: You are a duly sworn Federal marshal, with nationwide jurisdiction and the authority of the United States of America.

PROF_FOODP.name: True Foodperson
PROF_FOODP.description: You are the true Foodperson, some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  You are Foodperson, the mask has become your face; you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

PROF_MED.name: MD
PROF_MED.description: You were just through with the administrative formalities for your residency when the Cataclysm struck.  "Your" hospital was overrun and evacuated, but there's always work for a good doctor.

PROF_SKATER.name: Skater
PROF_SKATER.description: You spent a lot of time actively maneuvering on skates before the Cataclysm, and are better at staying on your feet when checked or blocked.

PROF_MA_ORANGE.name: Martial Artist
PROF_MA_ORANGE.description: You were shaping up to be a pretty decent student of the martial arts before the Cataclysm struck.  Time to see just how good you really are.

PROF_MA_BLACK.name: Black Belt
PROF_MA_BLACK.description: You were competitive at national levels, and had considered teaching your art.  Defending against the entire town may still be a challenge, though.

PROF_BOXER.name: Pugilist
PROF_BOXER.description: You are experienced in the Sweet Science of boxing.  You could've had a shot at a local boxing tournament, if the Cataclysm hadn't screwed that up.

PROF_AUTODOC.name: Autodoc Specialist
PROF_AUTODOC.description: You're trained in proper operation of the Autodoc, an advanced machine used for surgical procedures.  Operations involving it will be moderately more likely to succeed.

PROF_DICEMASTER.name: Dungeon Master
PROF_DICEMASTER.description: Weeks spent picking through manuals and researching topics you aren't versed in has taught you to find what you need to know more quickly.  You read slightly faster, and suffer no reading time penalty for books too complex for you to easily understand.

PROF_MILITARY.name: Military Remnant
PROF_MILITARY.description: You are a member of the United States Armed Forces, or what's left of it at least.

PROF_SWIMMER.name: Experienced Swimmer
PROF_SWIMMER.description: You have spent a large portion of your life swimming, granting you increased speed in water.

NPC_MISSION_LEV_1.name: Has Level 1 Companion Missions
NPC_MISSION_LEV_1.description: New mission options have become available!

NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_1.name: Has Level 1 Construction Built
NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_1.description: New options may have become available!

NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_2.name: Has Level 2 Construction Built
NPC_CONSTRUCTION_LEV_2.description: New options may have become available!

HALLUCINATION.name: Hallucination
HALLUCINATION.description: NPC trait that makes them be hallucination.  It is a bug if you have it.

DEBUG_NIGHTVISION.name: Debug Night Vision
DEBUG_NIGHTVISION.description: You can clearly see that this is for dev purposes only.

DEBUG_INFINITE_SPEED.name: Debug Infinite Speed
DEBUG_INFINITE_SPEED.description: The only problem with being faster than light is that you always live in darkness.

DEBUG_CLOAK.name: Debug Invisibility
DEBUG_CLOAK.description: If you see this, you'd best be debugging something.

DEBUG_LS.name: Debug Life Support
DEBUG_LS.description: Holds hunger, thirst, and fatigue stable.  You can debug all year long with this one!

DEBUG_NOSCENT.name: Debug Deodorizer
DEBUG_NOSCENT.description: Smell that bug?  Smell's certainly not coming from you!

DEBUG_SILENT.name: Debug Silent Walk
DEBUG_SILENT.description: Be vewwy vewwy quiet.  We're hunting bugs.

DEBUG_NOTEMP.name: Debug HVAC
DEBUG_NOTEMP.description: Temperature and weather won't bug you.

DEBUG_HS.name: Debug Hammerspace
DEBUG_HS.description: Crafting and construction requirements bugger off with this one.  Apply with care.

DEBUG_HT.name: Debug Hammertime
DEBUG_HT.description: Crafting and construction are practically instant.

DEBUG_MIND_CONTROL.name: Debug Mind Control
DEBUG_MIND_CONTROL.description: Mind the bugs, would you kindly?

DEBUG_STORAGE.name: Debug Carrying Capacity
DEBUG_STORAGE.description: Lets you carry 15 bugs worth of your body weight in your mandibles.

DEBUG_WEIGHTLESSNESS.name: Debug Weightlessness
DEBUG_WEIGHTLESSNESS.description: Newton discovered gravity in 1687. People before 1687:

DEBUG_BIONICS.name: Debug Bionic Installation
DEBUG_BIONICS.description: Lets you instantly install torsion ratchets for your eight legs.

DEBUG_STAMINA.name: Debug Infinite Stamina
DEBUG_STAMINA.description: Lets you run or swim forever (in other words, until you fix that bug).

BEE.name: Bee
BEE.description: NPC trait that makes monsters see it as a bee.  It is a bug (heh) if you have it.

MYCUS_FRIEND.name: mycus friend
MYCUS_FRIEND.description: NPC trait that makes fungaloid monsters see this NPC as a friend.

MUTE.name: mute
MUTE.description: NPC trait that makes it impossible to say anything.  It is a bug if you have it.

BRAWLER.name: Brawler
BRAWLER.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using ranged weapons is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

GUNSHY.name: Gun Shy
GUNSHY.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using firearms is completely off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.  Other ranged weapons, however, are totally fine.

GUNNUT.name: Gun Nut
GUNNUT.description: REAL survivors use guns!  You refuse to use crude bows, crossbows, or other primitive ranged weapons even if your life depends on it.

NOMAD.name: Nomad
NOMAD.description: You're too adventurous for your own good.  The more time you spend somewhere, the unhappier it makes you to be there.

WAYFARER.name: Wayfarer
WAYFARER.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, traveling with vehicles is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

FAST_REFLEXES.name: Fast Reflexes
FAST_REFLEXES.description: You have fast reflexes, allowing you to dodge attacks more easily.

FELINE_FLEXIBILITY.name: Feline Flexibility
FELINE_FLEXIBILITY.description: Your muscles, joints, and the movement center of your brain have changed internally somewhat, allowing you to traverse obstacles with ease.  It also helps you avoid attacks a bit more easily, and flex with falls to take less damage.

NO_RANGED_CRIT.name: No ranged crit
NO_RANGED_CRIT.description: You are not an intellectual shooter.  Your ranged shots no longer able to crit, and you more likely going to hit the body or limbs rather than the head.

LASER_GUIDED.name: Laser guided
LASER_GUIDED.description: Used by fake shooters spawned by laser-guided vehicle turrets, to increase accuracy.  If you have this, it's a bug.

HAS_NEMESIS.name: Hunted
HAS_NEMESIS.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.

PROF_FERAL.name: Lost To The Cataclysm
PROF_FERAL.description: Something inside you snapped.  Whether through wallowing in decay or by otherworldly influence, the living shun you while the undead mostly ignore you.  Your mind and body will deteriorate if you don't keep killing the living and sane.  Your fellow lost and damned will suffice too, but that might cause the others to mistake you for the living.

PROF_KNIGHT.name: Swordsman
PROF_KNIGHT.description: You have trained in the ways of the European nobility. Mostly useless even before the Cataclysm, now the only thing worth anything is the swordsmanship.

PROF_IRS.name: IRS Auditor
PROF_IRS.description: You possess authority nationwide to lawfully seize assets, detain individuals, and deploy lethal force in the collection of Uncle Sam's undeclared revenue. You are the IRS. You are inevitable.

CARRY_PERMIT.name: Carry Permit
CARRY_PERMIT.description: You prepared for trouble as best as you could, though it might not be enough for the end of the world.  In addition to any weapons your profession might start with, you start with a randomly-selected common pistol and some spare mags.  (Note: What you see in character creation does not reflect what it will select at game start.)

BLIND.name: Blind
BLIND.description: You're totally blind, requiring you to cautiously feel out your surroundings.  Prevents crafting and construction aside from simple tasks that can be done blindfolded, and hinders many other actions as well.

seer_mark.name: Mark of the Seer
seer_mark.description: A strange occult symbol carved into your hand by Brigitte LaCroix.

TRUTHTELLER.name: Truth Teller
TRUTHTELLER.description: I'd lie if I said this trait was worth a whole point.

PAINREC2.name: Quick Pain Recovery
PAINREC2.description: You recover from pain faster than normal.  DUMMIED OUT because it wasn't actually functional…

PAINREC3.name: Very Quick Pain Recovery
PAINREC3.description: You recover from pain much faster than normal.  DUMMIED OUT because it wasn't actually functional…

TABLEMANNERS.name: Rigid Table Manners
TABLEMANNERS.description: You've been taught proper table manners from your early childhood on.  Now you can't even think about eating without a table.  Eating without it frustrates you, but eating like a civilized person gives you a bigger morale bonus.

HATES_BOOKS.name: Hates Books
HATES_BOOKS.description: Reading is for nerds!  Boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.

TRIGGERHAPPY.name: Trigger Happy
TRIGGERHAPPY.description: Unimplemented.  To be removed after 0.F. to preserve save compatibility.

FORGETFUL.name: Forgetful
FORGETFUL.description: You have a hard time remembering things.  Your skills will erode slightly faster than usual, and you can remember less terrain.

CLAWS_RETRACT_active.name: Extended Claws
CLAWS_RETRACT_active.description: Sharp claws are extended from the end of your fingers.

PROF_HELI_PILOT.name: Helicopter Pilot
PROF_HELI_PILOT.description: Everyone can pilot a helicopter nowadays, you don't need this trait.

EATPOISON.name: Intestinal Fortitude
EATPOISON.description: Your guts have developed the ability to handle poisonous food.  Mostly.

INFIMMUNE.name: Infection Immune
INFIMMUNE.description: Your bloodstream has developed antibiotic properties.  Your wounds will never become infected.

DISRESISTANT.name: Disease Resistant
DISRESISTANT.description: It's very unlikely that you will catch ambient diseases like a cold or the flu.

DISIMMUNE.name: Disease Immune
DISIMMUNE.description: Your body is simply immune to diseases.  You will never catch an ambient disease.

GOODMEMORY.name: Good Memory
GOODMEMORY.description: You have an exceptional memory, and find it easy to remember things.  Your skills will erode slightly slower than usual.

NOMAD2.name: Antsy
NOMAD2.description: You can't bear to stay still for long.  Your morale will suffer unless you constantly explore new territory.

NOMAD3.name: Restless
NOMAD3.description: Spending any amount of time in familiar places makes you miserable.  Must.  Keep.  Moving.

ELFA_NV.name: Fey Vision
ELFA_NV.description: The shadows don't seem as dark now.

ELFA_FNV.name: Fey Nightsight
ELFA_FNV.description: You have great low-light vision now, though that doesn't allow you to perform fine tasks such as crafting and reading in darkness.

FEL_NV.name: Feline Vision
FEL_NV.description: Your optic nerves and brain caught up with your eyes.  Now you can see pretty well at night.

CEPH_VISION.name: Cephalopod Vision
CEPH_VISION.description: Your brain has caught up with your eyes.  You can see much better in the dark, but sunlight seems much brighter now.

URSINE_EYE.name: Ursine Vision
URSINE_EYE.description: Your visual processing has shifted: though you can see better in the dark, you're nearsighted in the light.  Maybe glasses would help.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.

TOUGH_FEET.name: Tough Feet
TOUGH_FEET.description: This mutation has been obsoleted due to the hidden movement speed penalty being removed.  If you see this on a profession or mutate this trait, this is a bug.

STYLISH.name: Stylish
STYLISH.description: Obsoleted due to becoming default behavior.

SELFAWARE.name: Self-Aware
SELFAWARE.description: This mutation is now just an option in the settings.

INCONSPICUOUS.name: Inconspicuous
INCONSPICUOUS.description: While sleeping or staying still, it is less likely that monsters will wander close to you.

SAVINGS.name: Savings
SAVINGS.description: You had some money stashed at the bank for a rainy day.  Now that the storm is raging, it's a last call to use it maybe?

DEBT.name: Debt
DEBT.description: You needed money and had a big loan in a bank.  Good thing nobody will come to collect it now, right?  Right?

MILLIONAIRE.name: Millionaire
MILLIONAIRE.description: At the time of Cataclysm you were an owner of a fortune stashed in a bank.  Does that have any meaning now?

PLANT.name: Plant
PLANT.mutagen_message: You feel much closer to nature.
PLANT.iv_message: You inject some nutrients into your phloem.

INSECT.name: Insect
INSECT.mutagen_message: You hear buzzing, and feel your body harden.
INSECT.iv_message: You sting yourself… for the Queen.

SPIDER.name: Spider
SPIDER.memorial_message: Found a place in the web of life.

SLIME.name: Slime
SLIME.mutagen_message: Your body loses all rigidity for a moment.
SLIME.iv_message: This stuff takes you back.  Downright primordial!
SLIME.memorial_message: Gave up on rigid human norms.
SLIME.junkie_message: Maybe if you drank enough, you'd become mutagen...

FISH.name: Fish
FISH.mutagen_message: You are overcome by an overwhelming longing for the ocean.
FISH.iv_message: Your pulse pounds as the waves.

RAT.name: Rat
RAT.iv_message: You squeak as the shot hits you.

BEAST.name: Beast
BEAST.mutagen_message: Your heart races and you see blood for a moment.
BEAST.iv_message: Your heart races wildly as the injection takes hold.

URSINE.name: Bear
URSINE.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to… patrol?  the forests?
URSINE.iv_message: You feel yourself quite equipped for wilderness survival.

FELINE.name: Feline
FELINE.mutagen_message: As you lap up the last of the mutagen, you wonder why...
FELINE.iv_message: Your back arches as the mutagen takes hold.

LUPINE.name: Wolf
LUPINE.mutagen_message: You feel an urge to mark your territory.  But then it passes.
LUPINE.iv_message: As the mutagen hits you, your ears twitch and you stifle a yipe.

CATTLE.name: Cattle
CATTLE.mutagen_message: Your mind and body slow down.  You feel peaceful.
CATTLE.iv_message: You wonder if this is what rBGH feels like...
CATTLE.memorial_message: Stopped worrying and learned to love the cowbell.

CEPHALOPOD.name: Cephalopod
CEPHALOPOD.mutagen_message: Your mind is overcome by images of eldritch horrors… and then they pass.
CEPHALOPOD.iv_message: You watch the mutagen flow through a maze of little twisty passages.  All the same.

BIRD.name: Bird
BIRD.mutagen_message: Your body lightens and you long for the sky.
BIRD.iv_message: Your arms spasm in an oddly wavelike motion.

LIZARD.name: Lizard
LIZARD.mutagen_message: For a heartbeat, your blood cools down.
LIZARD.iv_message: Your blood cools down.  The feeling is… different.

TROGLOBITE.name: Troglobite
TROGLOBITE.mutagen_message: You yearn for a cool, dark place to hide.
TROGLOBITE.iv_message: As you press the plunger, it all goes so bright...

ALPHA.name: Alpha
ALPHA.iv_message: You took that shot like a champ!

MEDICAL.name: Medical
MEDICAL.mutagen_message: You can feel the blood rushing through your veins and a strange, medicated feeling washes over your senses.
MEDICAL.iv_message: You can feel the blood in your medication stream.  It's a strange feeling.
MEDICAL.junkie_message: Ahh, there it is.  You can feel the mutagen again.

CHIMERA.name: Chimera
CHIMERA.mutagen_message: You need to roar, bask, bite, and flap.  NOW.
CHIMERA.iv_sleep_message: With a final *pop*, you go out like a light.

ELFA.name: Fey
ELFA.mutagen_message: Nature is becoming one with you...
ELFA.iv_message: Everything goes green for a second.
ELFA.memorial_message: Accepted a more natural way of life.

RAPTOR.name: Raptor
RAPTOR.mutagen_message: Mmm… sweet, bloody flavor… tastes like victory.
RAPTOR.iv_message: You distinctly smell the mutagen mixing with your blood… and then it passes.

MOUSE.name: Mouse
MOUSE.mutagen_message: You feel a desire to curl up in a nice, warm pile of… shredded paper.

RABBIT.name: Rabbit
RABBIT.mutagen_message: Walking is overrated.  It's time to start hopping.

SERPENT.name: Serpent
SERPENT.iv_message: You hiss, left reeling from the strange sensations.

Loss of health - Entire Body

bouldering.apply_message: You try to keep your balance.

name: Wearing earphones

glowy_led.apply_message: A bionic LED is glowing softly beneath your skin.

name: Poisoned Wound
desc: The wound swells visibly and burns like hell.
venom_dmg.remove_message: The burning pain subsides, but the damage is done.

name: Weakening Poison

venom_weaken.apply_message: The sting itself barely hurt, but suddenly you feel exhausted.
venom_weaken.remove_message: The weight on your chest lessens.

name: Food Poisoning

name: Pollen Inhalation
desc: The pollen makes it hard to breathe!
miss_messages: Your head is swimming from the pollen in the air.
