barter.name: Bartering
barter.description: Your skill in bargaining, haggling, and trading with others.  Higher levels increase the odds of getting the better end of a deal, and might even see you convincing others to give you free stuff.

speech.name: Speaking
speech.description: Your skill in speaking to other people.  Covers ability in boasting, flattery, threats, persuasion, lies, and other facets of interpersonal communication.  Works best in conjunction with a high level of intelligence.

computer.name: Computers
computer.description: Your skill in accessing and manipulating computers.  Higher levels can allow a user to navigate complex software systems and even bypass their security.

firstaid.name: First Aid
firstaid.description: Your skill in effecting emergency medical treatment.  Higher levels allow better use of medicines and items like bandages and first aid kits, and reduce the failure and complication rates of medical procedures.

mechanics.name: Mechanics
mechanics.description: Your skill in engineering, maintaining and repairing vehicles and other mechanical systems.  This skill covers the craft of items with complex parts, and plays a role in the installation of bionic equipment.

traps.name: Trapping
traps.description: Your skill in creating, setting, finding and disarming traps safely and effectively.  This skill does not affect the evasion of traps that are triggered.

driving.name: Driving
driving.description: Your skill in operating and steering a vehicle in motion.  A higher level allows greater control over vehicles at higher speeds, and reduces the penalty of shooting while driving.

swimming.name: Athletics
swimming.description: Your capability to perform physically demanding tasks such as running, jumping, climbing, and swimming efficiently. This skill influences your overall performance when swimming, reduces stamina consumption of physical activity, and reduces the impact of encumbrance.

fabrication.name: Fabrication
fabrication.description: Your skill in working with raw materials and shaping them into useful objects.  This skill plays an important role in the crafting of many objects.

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.description: Your skill in combining food ingredients to make other, tastier food items.  It may also be used in certain chemical mixtures and other, more esoteric tasks.

tailor.name: Tailoring
tailor.description: Your skill in the craft and repair of clothing, bags, blankets and other textiles.  Affects knitting, sewing, stitching, weaving, and nearly anything else involving a needle and thread.

survival.name: Survival
survival.description: Your skill in surviving the wilderness, and in crafting various basic survival items.  This also covers your ability to skin and butcher animals for meat and hides.

electronics.name: Electronics
electronics.description: Your skill in dealing with electrical systems, used in the craft and repair of objects with electrical components.  This skill is an important part of installing and managing bionic implants.

archery.name: Archery
archery.description: Your skill in using bow weapons, from hand-carved self bows to complex compound bows.  Quiet and effective, they require strength of body and sight to wield, and are not terribly accurate over a long distance.

gun.name: Marksmanship
gun.description: Your overall skill in using bows and firearms.  With higher levels, this general experience increases accuracy with any bows or firearms, but is secondary to practice with the type of ranged weapon in question.

launcher.name: Launchers
launcher.description: Your skill in using heavy weapons like rocket, grenade or missile launchers.  These weapons have a variety of applications and may carry immense destructive power, but they are cumbersome and hard to manage.

pistol.name: Handguns
pistol.description: Handguns have poor accuracy compared to rifles, but are usually quick to fire and reload faster than other guns.  They are very effective at close quarters, though unsuited for long range engagement.

rifle.name: Rifles
rifle.description: Rifles have terrific range and accuracy compared to other firearms, but may be slow to fire and reload, and can prove difficult to use in close quarters.  Fully automatic rifles can fire rapidly, but are harder to handle properly.

shotgun.name: Shotguns
shotgun.description: Shotguns are easy to shoot and can inflict massive damage, but their effectiveness and accuracy decline rapidly with range.  Slugs can be loaded into shotguns to provide greater range, though they are somewhat inaccurate.

smg.name: Submachine Guns
smg.description: Comprised of an automatic rifle carbine designed to fire a pistol cartridge, submachine guns can reload and fire quickly, sometimes in bursts, but they are relatively inaccurate and may be prone to mechanical failures.

throw.name: Throwing
throw.description: Your skill in throwing objects over a distance.  Skill increases accuracy, and at higher levels, the range of a throw.

melee.name: Melee
melee.description: Your skill and finesse in personal combat, both with and without a weapon.  Higher levels can significantly increase the accuracy and effectiveness of your physical attacks.

bashing.name: Bashing Weapons
bashing.description: Your skill in fighting with blunt weaponry, from rocks and sticks to baseball bats and the butts of rifles.  Skill increases damage, and higher levels will improve the accuracy of an attack.

cutting.name: Cutting Weapons
cutting.description: Your skill in fighting with weaponry designed to cut, hack and slash an opponent.  Lower levels of skill increase accuracy and damage, while higher levels will help to bypass heavy armor and thick hides.

dodge.name: Dodging
dodge.description: Your ability to dodge an oncoming threat, be it an enemy's attack, a triggered trap, or a falling rock.  This skill is also used in attempts to fall gracefully, and for other acrobatic feats.  The first number shown includes modifiers, and the second does not.

stabbing.name: Piercing Weapons
stabbing.description: Your skill in fighting with knives, spears and other such stabbing implements.  Skill increases attack accuracy as well as the chance of inflicting a deadly and critical blow.

unarmed.name: Unarmed Combat
unarmed.description: Your skill in hand-to-hand fighting, with unarmed weapons or empty-handed.  Skill increases attack accuracy and unlocks techniques in many martial arts, while also providing a bonus to bare-handed damage.

DEBUG.name: debug monster
DEBUG.description: a debug monster used for testing. Please report this.

bio_adrenaline.name: Adrenaline Pump
bio_adrenaline.description: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_ads.name: Active Defense System
bio_ads.description: This bionic charges a forcefield around your body that deflects incoming attacks.  Bullets are heavily deflected, piercing well deflected, slashing moderately deflected and bashing barely deflected.  This bionic charges at half speed for 3 turns after being hit, and doesn't consume power when fully charged.

bio_wings.name: Thermofluidic Propulsion Modules
bio_wings.description: These advanced propulsion modules utilize thermofluidic principles to generate lift and controlled thrust, allowing the user to achieve limited levitation and short-range flight.  When toggled on, they emit directed thermal energy through micro-thrusters to maneuver over obstacles or hazardous terrain.  Energy is consumed both during activation and sustained operation.

bio_alarm.name: Alarm System
bio_alarm.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.

bio_ankles.name: Squeaky Ankles
bio_ankles.description: In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.

bio_armor_arms.name: Alloy Plating - Arms
bio_armor_arms.description: The flesh on your arms and hands have been surgically replaced by alloy plating.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, 5 ballistic protection, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_eyes.name: Protective Lenses
bio_armor_eyes.description: Your eye sockets have been surgically sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  Provides 3 bash and cut protection, and 7 environmental protection.

bio_armor_head.name: Alloy Plating - Head
bio_armor_head.description: The flesh on your head has been surgically replaced by alloy plating, protecting both your head and jaw regions.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, and 5 ballistic protection.

bio_armor_legs.name: Alloy Plating - Legs
bio_armor_legs.description: The flesh on your legs and feet have been surgically replaced by alloy plating.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, 5 ballistic protection, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_torso.name: Alloy Plating - torso
bio_armor_torso.description: The flesh on your torso has been surgically replaced by alloy plating, protecting it from physical trauma.  Provides 6 bash and cut protection, and 5 ballistic protection.

bio_batteries.name: Battery System
bio_batteries.description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use 'E' to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

bio_blade.name: Monomolecular Blade
bio_blade.description: A deadly 30cm-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

bio_monowire.name: Monofilament Whip
bio_monowire.description: Your left hand conceals three meters of monomolecular filament on an artificial diamond spool, extending behind a small counterweight in your thumbtip.  It requires a small amount of bionic power to activate, and prevents you from holding anything else while extended.

bio_shotgun.name: Shotgun Arm
bio_shotgun.description: Concealed in your left arm is a 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.

bio_blindfold.name: Optical Dampers
bio_blindfold.description: The lenses surgically installed over your eyes can be tinted to block out incoming light.

bio_blood_anal.name: Blood Analysis
bio_blood_anal.description: Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

bio_blood_filter.name: Blood Filter
bio_blood_filter.description: A filtration system in your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.

bio_cable.name: Cable Charger System
bio_cable.description: You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via cable.

bio_cable_mkII.name: Cable Charger System Mk. II
bio_cable_mkII.description: This is a military-grade electronic port and power converter system which are surgically mounted above your hip, it has ten times higher throughput than basic version.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via cable.

bio_carbon.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament
bio_carbon.description: Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This reduces all bashing damage by 5%, cutting damage by 10%, and ballistic damage by 15%.

bio_chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
bio_chain_lightning.description: Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

bio_claws.name: Bionic Claws
bio_claws.description: Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your hands, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

bio_climate.name: Internal Climate Control
bio_climate.description: Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.

bio_cloak.name: Cloaking System
bio_cloak.description: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

bio_cqb.name: Close Quarters Battle
bio_cqb.description: Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  Whilst active, the CQB module will improve your hand to hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.

bio_deformity.name: Bionic-Induced Deformity
bio_deformity.description: A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.

bio_dex_enhancer.name: Wired Reflexes
bio_dex_enhancer.description: Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity.

bio_digestion.name: Expanded Digestive System
bio_digestion.description: You have been outfitted with a synthetic stomach and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are immune to foodborne illness, parasites, and can even eat rotten food.

bio_dis_acid.name: Acidic Discharge
bio_dis_acid.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.

bio_dis_shock.name: Electrical Discharge
bio_dis_shock.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.

bio_drain.name: Electrical Drain
bio_drain.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.

bio_earplugs.name: Sound Dampeners
bio_earplugs.description: When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely (with Enhanced Hearing deactivated) or dampen sound slightly (with Enhanced Hearing activated).

bio_ears.name: Enhanced Hearing
bio_ears.description: When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing, and preexisting hearing problems will be fixed.

bio_emp_armgun.name: EMP Projector
bio_emp_armgun.description: A ranged EMP generator system is implanted on the palm of your right hand and arm.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.

bio_ethanol.name: Ethanol Burner
bio_ethanol.description: You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.

bio_evap.name: Aero-Evaporator
bio_evap.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

bio_eye_enhancer.name: Diamond Cornea
bio_eye_enhancer.description: Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception and fixing any vision problems short of total blindness.

bio_eye_optic.name: Telescopic Lenses
bio_eye_optic.description: The lenses in your eyes have been surgically removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  They function as integrated binoculars, letting you see much farther than before, and any mundane vision problems you might have had are now gone, including blindness.
bio_eye_optic.no_uninstall_reason: The telescopic lenses are part of the patient's eyes now, remove them and the patient would become blind

bio_face_mask.name: Facial Distortion
bio_face_mask.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

bio_faraday.name: Dielectric Capacitance System
bio_faraday.description: Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

bio_fingerhack.name: Fingerhack
bio_fingerhack.description: One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.

bio_flashbang.name: Flashbang Generator
bio_flashbang.description: Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.

bio_minirose.name: Minirose
bio_minirose.description: A dead man's switch and literal mininuke wired through the torso and major blood vessels.  It can be armed or disabled, and detonates upon death while armed or manual trigger.  You wouldn't want to use it, unless you'd like to demonstrate the bottomless malice within the human heart to a certain ant.

bio_flashlight.name: Cranial Flashlight
bio_flashlight.description: Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.

bio_tattoo_led.name: LED Tattoo
bio_tattoo_led.description: A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light, but it can suffice for reading or crafting if you have nothing else.

bio_glowy.name: Glowy Thing
bio_glowy.description: You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

bio_geiger.name: Integrated Dosimeter
bio_geiger.description: Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

bio_gills.name: Respirator
bio_gills.description: A complex respiration augmentation system.  Improves respiration ability in air and allows breathing water.  Will automatically turn on when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.  Asthmatics may also use it to stop asthma attacks.

bio_grossfood.name: Taste Fouler
bio_grossfood.description: A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.

bio_ground_sonar.name: Terranian Sonar
bio_ground_sonar.description: Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

bio_heat_absorb.name: Heat Drain
bio_heat_absorb.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

bio_heatsink.name: Thermal Dissipation
bio_heatsink.description: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.

bio_hydraulics.name: Hydraulic Muscles
bio_hydraulics.description: While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.

bio_infolink.name: Bionic Infolink
bio_infolink.description: A state of the art communications and information package has been installed in your body.  While the cell phone network may be down, it can still double as a two-way radio.  Additionally tells you the time and local air temperature, provides a silent alarm clock function, and if activated will give a more detailed readout on local weather conditions.

bio_infrared.name: Infrared Vision
bio_infrared.description: Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.

bio_int_enhancer.name: Cerebral Booster
bio_int_enhancer.description: Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence.

bio_itchy.name: Itchy Metal Thing
bio_itchy.description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.

bio_laser.name: Finger-Mounted Laser
bio_laser.description: One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

bio_leaky.name: Leaky Bionic
bio_leaky.description: This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

bio_leukocyte.name: Leukocyte Breeder System
bio_leukocyte.description: You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

bio_lighter.name: Finger Lighter
bio_lighter.description: The index fingers of both hands have powerful fire starters which extend from the tip.

bio_lockpick.name: Fingerpick
bio_lockpick.description: One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.  If you're crouched or prone, examining a locked door will have you prioritize picking the lock instead of using a crowbar on it.

bio_magnet.name: Electromagnetic Unit
bio_magnet.description: Surgically embedded in your right hand is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

bio_membrane.name: Nictating Membrane
bio_membrane.description: Your eyes have a thin membrane that closes over your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

bio_memory.name: Enhanced Memory Banks
bio_memory.description: Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you can't forget skills you've already learned.

bio_metabolics.name: Metabolic Interchange
bio_metabolics.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

bio_nanobots.name: Repair Nanobots
bio_nanobots.description: Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will reduce the intensity of one bleed effect every 30 seconds, and heal all injured body parts by 1 HP (or broken limbs by 1%) every 2 minutes if you have 3 kJ bionic power and 5 kcal per body part.  If you don't have enough, they will prioritize based on the resources you have.

bio_night.name: Artificial Night Generator
bio_night.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.

bio_gas_remover.name: Contaminant Particle Ionizer
bio_gas_remover.description: When active, this bionic emits a low energy electric field, causing dangerous airborne particles such as smoke and poison gas within a 5 tile radius to ionize and dissipate rapidly.

bio_night_vision.name: Implanted Night Vision
bio_night_vision.description: When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.

bio_noise.name: Noisemaker
bio_noise.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.

bio_nostril.name: Bionic Nostril
bio_nostril.description: You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

bio_ods.name: Offensive Defense System
bio_ods.description: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

bio_painkiller.name: Sensory Dulling
bio_painkiller.description: Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  This also means you do not need anesthesia when undergoing bionic surgery with an Autodoc.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.

bio_pokedeye.name: Bionic Visual Impairment
bio_pokedeye.description: Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

bio_power_armor_interface.name: Power Armor Interface
bio_power_armor_interface.description: Interfaces your bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Twice as efficient as using a UPS.

bio_power_armor_interface_mkII.name: Power Armor Interface Mk. II
bio_power_armor_interface_mkII.description: Interfaces your bionic power system with the internal charging port on suits of power armor, allowing them to draw from the user's bionic power banks.  Four times as efficient as using a UPS, the Mk. II was designed by DoubleTech Inc., to meet the popularity of the Mk. II power armor series.

bio_power_storage.name: Power Storage
bio_power_storage.description: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

bio_power_storage_mkII.name: Power Storage Mk. II
bio_power_storage_mkII.description: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.

bio_power_weakness.name: Power Overload
bio_power_weakness.description: Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

bio_probability_travel.name: Probability Travel
bio_probability_travel.description: Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Activate and select a direction to use.  Tunneling costs 100 bionic power per tile traveled through.

bio_purifier.name: Air Filtration System (passive)
bio_purifier.description: Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  In it's passive form it will protect you against smoke inhalation and even particulate matter that triggers asthma attacks.  Once activated, it will prevent spores, toxins and diseases from being inhaled.

bio_purifier_active.name: Air Filtration System (active)
bio_purifier_active.description: Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  In it's passive form it will protect you against smoke inhalation.  Once activated, it will prevent spores, toxins and diseases from being inhaled.

bio_radscrubber.name: Radiation Scrubber System
bio_radscrubber.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.  While activated if irradiated stacks are present will remove 1 stack of irradiated every 10 minutes costing 10kJ.

bio_railgun.name: Railgun
bio_railgun.description: EM field generators in your arms double the range and increase damage of thrown iron and steel objects at a cost of 1kJ per throw, causing them to leave a trail of electricity that can cause additional damage.

bio_razors.name: Fingertip Razors
bio_razors.description: You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a fair amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered, and which you can use with some precision to cut and butcher..

bio_recycler.name: Recycler Unit
bio_recycler.description: Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

bio_remote.name: Remote Controller
bio_remote.description: A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

bio_resonator.name: Sonic Resonator
bio_resonator.description: Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

bio_scent_mask.name: Olfactory Mask
bio_scent_mask.description: While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.

bio_shakes.name: Bionic Short Circuit
bio_shakes.description: A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

bio_synaptic_regen.name: Synaptic Regeneration System
bio_synaptic_regen.description: An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you won't become sleep deprived; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will boost the rate of recovery while you sleep.

bio_shock.name: Electroshock Unit
bio_shock.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

bio_shockwave.name: Shockwave Generator
bio_shockwave.description: You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

bio_sleepy.name: Endocrine Enervator
bio_sleepy.description: Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause fatigue.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

bio_sleep_shutdown.name: Sleep Mode Shutdown
bio_sleep_shutdown.description: For better or worse, this CBM suppresses most stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up from those causes.

bio_spasm.name: Motor Control Overstimulator
bio_spasm.description: One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.

bio_speed.name: Synaptic Accelerator
bio_speed.description: Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.

bio_stiff.name: Wire-Induced Stiffness
bio_stiff.description: Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.

bio_str_enhancer.name: Muscle Augmentation
bio_str_enhancer.description: Your muscular system has been surgically enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength.

bio_surgical_razor.name: Autonomous Surgical Scalpels
bio_surgical_razor.description: A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted on your fingers.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

bio_sunglasses.name: Anti-Glare Compensators
bio_sunglasses.description: Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.

bio_targeting.name: Targeting System
bio_targeting.description: Your eyes are surgically equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.

bio_teleport.name: Teleportation Unit
bio_teleport.description: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

bio_thumbs.name: Self-Locking Thumbs
bio_thumbs.description: Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

bio_time_freeze.name: Time Dilation
bio_time_freeze.description: At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.

bio_tools.name: Integrated Toolset
bio_tools.description: Surgically implanted in your hands and fingers is a set of tools - screwdriver, hammer, wrench, hacksaw, drill, welder, and heating elements.  You can use this in place of many tools when crafting.

bio_torsionratchet.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet
bio_torsionratchet.description: Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.

bio_jointservo.name: Joint Servo
bio_jointservo.description: Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort.  When unpowered, the bionic still improves your speed slightly by balancing your gait and preventing incorrect or excessive movements, even compensating for joint problems.

bio_trip.name: Visual Disruptor
bio_trip.description: A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.

bio_uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
bio_uncanny_dodge.description: Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, increasing your ability to dodge while active.  Your dodge skill will also grant a chance to evade attacks beyond normal human capability, such as bullets.

bio_underwater_propellers.name: Underwater Propellers
bio_underwater_propellers.description: Your upper torso is fitted with retractable propellers that enable you to swim and maneuver at greater speeds when submerged.

bio_ups.name: Internal Unified Power System
bio_ups.description: You have a Unified Power System wired into your power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now draw directly from your bionic power supply.

bio_voice.name: Voice Remodulator
bio_voice.description: You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.

bio_water_extractor.name: Water Extraction Unit
bio_water_extractor.description: Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.description: A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.

bio_fuel_cell_hydrogen.name: Hydrogen Fuel Cell CBM
bio_fuel_cell_hydrogen.description: A small hydrogen fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Fairly efficient and high-yield, though the low density of compressed hydrogen and potential waste heat is a hindrance.  A network of compressors and fuel tanks has been distributed throughout your body, able to compactly store 2 liters of hydrogen.

bio_reactor.name: Micro Reactor
bio_reactor.description: This stripped down mini-reactor generates impressive amounts of bionic power but slowly irradiates the user when in use.  1 plutonium fuel cell provides 1000 charges producing 10kW of power.  Produces 50W of power while inactive.

bio_advreactor.name: Advanced Micro Reactor
bio_advreactor.description: This stripped down mini-reactor has been heavily modified and is more efficient and safer than the base model.  1 plutonium fuel cell provides 1500 charges producing 10kW of power.  Produces 75W of power while inactive.

bio_reactoroverride.name: Micro Reactor Safety Override
bio_reactoroverride.description: Disables the radiation safety protocols allowing for much higher energy production.  While active produces 40kW of power and 1 irradiated stack every 20 turns.

bio_atomic_battery.name: Atomic Battery
bio_atomic_battery.description: A compact alphavoltaic power source, producing a steady source of limitless bionic power.  Produces 50W of power while active.

bio_syringe.name: Intravenous Needletip
bio_syringe.description: The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

bio_weight.name: Skeletal Bracing
bio_weight.description: A framework of lightweight alloy bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain and fixing any spinal issues.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds.

bio_storage.name: Internal Storage
bio_storage.description: Space inside your chest cavity has been surgically converted into a storage area.  You may carry an extra 2 liters of volume.

bio_shock_absorber.name: Kinetic Shock Absorbers
bio_shock_absorber.description: Most of the flesh in your arms, legs, and upper torso has been replaced with industrial-strength springs and protective padding.  Clenching your fist allows you to fold and unfold this padding; while active, the hydraulic absorbers will prevent damage to your body from severe impacts, at the cost of impaired movement.

bio_taste_blocker.name: Taste Modifier
bio_taste_blocker.description: A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.

bio_soporific.name: Soporific Induction
bio_soporific.description: An electrode has been implanted into your brain's ventrolateral preoptic nucleus.  It turns on whenever you're trying to fall asleep, creating an artificial but effective sensation of fatigue.

bn_bio_solar.name: Solar Panels
bn_bio_solar.description: Installed on your back is a set of retractable, reinforced solar panels resembling angular butterfly wings.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.

afs_bio_missiles.name: Deployable Grenade Launcher
afs_bio_missiles.description: Your right hand can fold inward to reveal a mechanism capable of igniting and firing 40mm grenades across medium distances with great accuracy due built in ballistic calculator.

afs_bio_linguistic_coprocessor.name: Linguistic Coprocessor
afs_bio_linguistic_coprocessor.description: The left hemisphere of your brain has been augmented with a microcomputer that moderately increases the speed that language and written words are processed, granting a 25% increase to reading speed.

afs_bio_dopamine_stimulators.name: Dopamine Stimulators
afs_bio_dopamine_stimulators.description: Tiny cybernetic stimulators have been installed throughout your ventral tegmental area, and trigger at set intervals using bionic power.  This slowly releases a stream of reward chemicals and hormones into your brain, inducing a state of euphoria that notably elevates mood.

bio_blaster.name: Fusion Blaster Arm
bio_blaster.description: A heavy-duty fusion blaster was integrated into your left arm!  You may use your energy banks to fire a damaging heat ray.

bio_electrosense.name: Electrosense Scanner
bio_electrosense.description: Activating this bionic will allow you to see robots and other electric creatures through walls, at the cost of steadily draining power.

bio_electrosense_voltmeter.name: Electrosense Voltmeter
bio_electrosense_voltmeter.description: Using this bionic allows you to check the status of any local grid connections or battery charge in your surroundings, as well as make modifications to grid connections.

bio_electrosense_bscanner.name: Electrosense Bionic Scanner
bio_electrosense_bscanner.description: Activating this bionic scans nearby corpses for bionics at 750J per bionic.  If you do not possess enough bionic power to scan 1 bionic, it deactivates.

bio_perpetual_test.name: Perpetual Generator
bio_perpetual_test.description: Installed within you is a perpetual generator powered by nonsensoleum.  When activated its power gen doubles.  If you are seeing this, you'd better be debugging.

debug_bio_fuel_cell.name: Debug Fuel Cell CBM
debug_bio_fuel_cell.description: The power of the sun, in the palm of my hand!  Installed within you is a perpetual generator powered by nonsensoleum.  When activated its power gen doubles.  If you are seeing this, you'd better be debugging.

bio_portal_tap.name: Dimensional Portal Tap
bio_portal_tap.description: An implanted interface for siphoning power from a linked dimensional portal.  Must be linked to a specific portal by examining it.  While the linked portal's grid has power, this bionic passively draws energy into your reserves each turn.

bio_furnace.name: Internal Furnace
bio_furnace.description: When this bionic is active, you can burn nearly any organic material as fuel (use 'E'), recharging your power level.  Some materials will burn better than others.

bio_emp.name: Directional EMP
bio_emp.description: Surgically mounted in the palm of your hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

bio_watch.name: Obsolete Bionic
bio_watch.description: The effects of this bionic in the code have been replaced with Bionic Infolink.  It can be uninstalled at minimum difficulty.

bio_meteorologist.name: Obsolete Bionic
bio_meteorologist.description: The effects of this bionic in the code have been replaced with Bionic Infolink.  It can be uninstalled at minimum difficulty.

bio_tools_extend.name: Extended Toolset
bio_tools_extend.description: Extend or withdraw your integrated toolset to cut metal, pry things, or other stuff.  This takes up your hands.

bio_scent_vision.name: Scent Vision
bio_scent_vision.description: While this system is powered, you're able to visually sense your own scent, making it possible for you to recognize your surroundings even in complete darkness.

fault_bionic_nonsterile.name: Non-sterile
fault_bionic_nonsterile.description: This bionic needs to be sterilized before it can be installed.

mending_methods.name: Sterilize using autoclave
mending_methods.success_msg: You successfully package and sterilize the %s using an autoclave.

fault_gun_blackpowder.name: Blackpowder fouling
fault_gun_blackpowder.description: Firing blackpowder loads from a gun fouls it, which reduces reliability and, if left uncleaned, leads to rust.  It fouls the gun much faster than the use of modern smokeless powder cartridges.  Fouling is only a significant impact on reliability at high levels, but black powder fouling accumulates quickly.

fault_gun_chamber_spent.name: Spent casing in chamber
fault_gun_chamber_spent.description: This gun currently has an empty casing chambered.  It will have to be removed before firing.

mending_methods.name: Eject spent casing
mending_methods.success_msg: You eject the spent casing from the %s.

fault_gun_unlubricated.name: Unlubricated
fault_gun_unlubricated.description: Either this gun is brand new and came without lubrication or it was recently cleaned with a solvent without oiling afterwards.  Either way, it's not lubricated and will not cycle properly, and can even be damaged.

fault_gun_dirt.name: Fouling
fault_gun_dirt.description: Fouling is caused by firing gunpowder loads repeatedly, which reduces reliability and can eventually cause damage to the gun.  Fouling accumulates slowly (unless blackpowder is used) due to the design of modern smokeless powder found in the vast majority of retail cartridges and it is not a significant problem until high levels of fouling are reached due to firing thousands of rounds without cleaning your firearm.

fault_bionic_salvaged.name: Already deployed
fault_bionic_salvaged.description: This bionic needs to be reset to its factory state.

mending_methods.name: Reset to factory state
mending_methods.success_msg: You successfully reset the %s to its factory state

fault_gun_clogged.name: Dusty
fault_gun_clogged.description: It's dusty.  Has no effect - obsolete fault.

fault_engine_belt_drive.name: Worn drive belt
fault_engine_belt_drive.description: Attached alternators will not produce any power.

mending_methods.name: Replace worn drive belt
mending_methods.description: Remove the old drive belt and install a new one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You wrap a new drive belt around the %s's components.

fault_engine_glow_plug.name: Faulty glow plugs
fault_engine_glow_plug.description: Impairs the engine's ability to start in low temperatures.

mending_methods.name: Replace faulty glow plugs
mending_methods.description: Disconnect the faulty glow plugs and install a new set.
mending_methods.success_msg: You disconnect the %s's faulty glow plugs and insert new ones.

fault_engine_immobiliser.name: Active immobiliser
fault_engine_immobiliser.description: Prevents the engine from starting.  An immobiliser stops a vehicle from running without the appropriate key; since you don't have that key, you'll need to manually deactivate it instead.

mending_methods.name: Deactivate immobiliser
mending_methods.description: Deactivate the immobiliser that's preventing the vehicle from starting.

fault_engine_pump_diesel.name: Faulty diesel pump
fault_engine_pump_diesel.description: Prevents the engine from starting.  A damaged pump means that diesel can't be pumped and pressurized from the vehicle's tank.

mending_methods.name: Replace faulty diesel pump
mending_methods.description: Depressurize the fuel line and replace the broken pump with a new one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You depressurize the fuel line and swap out the %s's faulty diesel pump.

fault_engine_filter_air.name: Expired air filter
fault_engine_filter_air.description: Heavily increases fuel consumption, and causes the engine to produce more exhaust.

mending_methods.name: Replace expired air filter
mending_methods.description: Replace the expired air filter with a clean one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You swap the %s's air filter and discard the old one.

fault_engine_filter_fuel.name: Expired fuel filter
fault_engine_filter_fuel.description: Reduces the engine's performance, and increases the risk of backfires or failures to start.

mending_methods.name: Replace expired fuel filter
mending_methods.description: Replace the expired fuel filter with a clean one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You swap the %s's fuel filter and discard the old one.

fault_engine_pump_fuel.name: Faulty fuel pump
fault_engine_pump_fuel.description: Prevents the engine from starting.  A damaged pump means that gasoline can't be pumped from the vehicle's tank.

mending_methods.name: Replace fuel pump
mending_methods.description: Drain the gas line and replace the broken pump with a new one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You drain the gas line and swap out the %s's fuel pump with a new one.

fault_engine_pump_water.name: Defective water pump
fault_engine_pump_water.description: Has no immediate effects, but can impair long-term engine health.  A non-functional water pump prevents the engine from properly being cooled, increasing the risk of eventual damage from overheating.

mending_methods.name: Replace defective water pump
mending_methods.description: Replace the defective water pump with a new one.
mending_methods.success_msg: You replace the %s's defective water pump.

fault_engine_starter.name: Faulty starter motor
fault_engine_starter.description: Prevents the engine from starting.  A broken starter means that the energy required to start ignition can't be delivered to the engine.

mending_methods.name: Replace faulty starter motor
mending_methods.description: Remove the faulty starter motor, and replace it with a functioning one.

morale_play_with_pet.text: Spent time playing with a pet

morale_butcher.text: Anguished by memories of butchering human corpse

ALLOWS_FLIGHT.info: This gear <info>allows flight</info> when active, at the cost of <info>power from a UPS</info>.

BODY_CLEANSER.info: Safe to use as a body cleanser while bathing.

ALLOWS_CLAWS.info: This clothing is <good>uniquely compatible</good> with mutants possessing <info>clawed fingers</info>.

ALLOWS_CLAWS_FOOT.info: This clothing is <good>uniquely compatible</good> with mutants possessing <info>toe claws</info>.

ALLOWS_HOOVES.info: This clothing is <good>uniquely compatible</good> with mutants possessing <info>hooves, foot-paws, or otherwise altered feet</info>.

ALLOWS_WINGS.info: This clothing is <good>uniquely compatible</good> with mutants possessing <info>wings</info>.

ALLOWS_MUZZLE.info: This clothing is <good>uniquely compatible</good> with mutants possessing <info>a snout, beak, or mandibles</info>.

ALLOWS_NATURAL_ATTACKS.info: This clothing won't hinder special attacks that involve <info>mutated anatomy</info>.

BELT_CLIP.info: This item can be clipped on to a <info>belt loop</info> of the appropriate size.

BIONIC_INSTALLATION_DATA.info: This item <info>provides</info> instructions and other required data for several bionics, allowing installation of them with <good>minimal failure chance</good>.

GENOME_DRIVE.info: This item stores <info>genetic data</info> for a genome workstation.

BIONIC_NPC_USABLE.info: A <good>follower</good> could <info>make use of this CBM</info> if installed properly.

BLINDS_EYES_ON_HIT.info: When thrown and it hits a creature's head, it can <bad>blind</bad> them.

BLIND_EASY.info: This is easy to do in the dark.

BLIND_HARD.info: This is difficult to do in the dark.

BLIND_NEARLY_IMPOSSIBLE.info: This is incredibly difficult to do in the dark, and impossible if you cannot see.

BLIND_IMPOSSIBLE.info: This is cannot be done if you cannot see.

BLOCK_WHILE_WORN.info: This item can be used to block attacks when worn.

CBM.info: This item is a Compact Bionic Module.  You'll need to <info>use specialized machinery</info> or <info>ask a surgeon</info> to install it into your body.

CLIMATE_CONTROL.info: This clothing has <info>built-in or attached climate control</info>, keeping you at a <good>comfortable temperature</good>.

COLLAR.info: This clothing has a <info>wide collar</info> that can keep your mouth warm if it is unencumbered.

DEAF.info: This gear <bad>prevents</bad> you from <info>hearing any sounds</info>.

DIAMOND.info: This item has a <good>diamond coating</good> improving its <info>cutting or piercing damage</info>.

DIG_TOOL.info: While wielded, this item allows you to mine through rocks and other hard obstacles by moving into tiles with them.  Note that automatic mining option should be set to true for this to work.

DURABLE_MELEE.info: As a weapon, this item is <good>well-made</good> and will <info>withstand the punishment of combat</info>.

CANT_HEAL_EVERYONE.info: This med can't be used by everyone, it requires a special mutation.

ELECTRIC_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>electric discharges</info>.

ETHEREAL_ITEM.info: This item disappears as soon as its timer runs out whether it is food or not.

BIO_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>biological damage</info>.

BASH_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>bash damage</info>.

CUT_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>cut damage</info>.

BULLET_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>bullet damage</info>.

ACID_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>acid damage</info>.

STAB_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>stab damage</info>.

COLD_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>low temperatures</info>.

DARK_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>dark damage</info>.

LIGHT_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>light damage</info>.

PSI_IMMUNE.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>psionic damage</info>.

FIRE.info: This item counts as <color_red>fire</color> for crafting purposes.

FIREWOOD.info: This item can serve as firewood.

FLASH_PROTECTION.info: This clothing will <good>partially protect from a flash from a flashbang</good>.

FLOTATION.info: This clothing <info>prevents going underwater</info> including both <good>drowning</good> and <bad>diving</bad>.

FIN.info: This clothing has fins that <good>improve swimming speed</good>, but <bad>reduce movement speed</bad> on land.

FRAGILE.info: This gear is <bad>fragile</bad> and <info>won't protect you for long</info>.

FRAGILE_MELEE.info: As a weapon, this item is <bad>flimsy</bad> and <info>won't last long in combat</info> before breaking apart.

GAS_PROOF.info: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>any gas</info>.

HOLSTER_PISTOL.info: This item can be carried in a <info>holster</info> of the appropriate size.

HOOD.info: This clothing has a <info>hood</info> to keep your head warm if your head is unencumbered.

HEATS_FOOD.info: This item will be used to <good>heat food</good> before eating food that is best eaten hot.

HEATS_FOOD_IS_CONSUMED.info: This item can be used to <good>heat food</good>, but will <bad>be destroyed afterwards</bad>.

HEATS_FOOD_USING_CHARGES.info: This item can be used to <good>heat food</good> using <info>charges</info>.

HEATS_FOOD_USING_FIRE.info: This item will be used to <good>heat food</good> over <info>fire</info>.

HYGROMETER.info: This gear is equipped with an accurate hygrometer (which is used to <info>measure humidity</info>).

IRREMOVABLE.info: This item is a component of the gun it is attached to.  It can't be removed without destroying it.

NATURE_CAMO.info: This gear <good>greatly reduces your detection range</good> when worn in <info>natural environments</info>.

URBAN_CAMO.info: This gear <good>greatly reduces your detection range</good> when worn in <info>urban and rocky environments</info>.

OUTER.info: This gear is generally <info>worn over</info> clothing.

OVERSIZE.info: This clothing is large enough to accommodate <info>abnormally large mutated anatomy</info>.

resized_large.info: This gear has been modified to accommodate <info>abnormally large mutated anatomy</info> with some <bad>increase to encumbrance</bad>.

resized_small.info: This gear has been modified to accommodate <info>abnormally small mutants</info> with some <bad>increase to encumbrance</bad>.

PARTIAL_DEAF.info: This gear <good>reduces</good> the volume of <info>sounds</info> to a safe level.

POCKETS.info: This clothing has <info>pockets</info> to warm your hands when you are wielding nothing.

POLEARM.info: As a weapon, this item <info>needs considerable space to use</info> properly and <bad>does 70% of its normal damage to adjacent enemies</bad>.

SPAWN_FRIENDLY.info: Any creature spawned from this item will <info>always</info> emerge <good>friendly to you</good>.

SPAWN_HOSTILE.info: Any creature spawned from this item will <info>always</info> emerge <bad>against you</good>.

NO_BLOAT.info: This comestible can be <good>eaten even on full stomach</good>.

PSYSHIELD_PARTIAL.info: This gear <good>keeps out</good> the <info>mind control rays</info>.

REQUIRES_BALANCE.info: This gear requires careful balance to use.  Being hit while wearing it could make you <bad>fall down</bad>.

TWO_WAY_RADIO.info: This item can be used to communicate with radio waves.

PERFECT_LOCKPICK.info: This item can be used to <info>pick locks</info> with <good>zero effort</good>.

RAINPROOF.info: This clothing is designed to keep you <info>dry</info> in the rain.

SEMITANGIBLE.info: It seems <info>partially intangible</info>, and can occupy the same space as other things when worn.

SKINTIGHT.info: This clothing <info>lies close</info> to the skin.

SLOWS_MOVEMENT.info: This clothing is restrictive and <bad>slows your movement speed</bad>.

SLOWS_THIRST.info: This clothing <good>slows your thirst</good> by reducing moisture loss.

STURDY.info: This clothing will <good>protect</good> you from harm and withstand <info>a lot of abuse</info>.

SUN_GLASSES.info: This clothing keeps the <info>glare</info> out of your eyes.

SWIM_GOGGLES.info: This clothing allows you to <good>see much further</good> <info>under water</info>.

THERMOMETER.info: This gear is equipped with an <info>accurate thermometer</info>.

WAIST.info: This gear is worn on or around your <info>waist</info>.

WATCH.info: This gear allows to see <info>actual time</info>.

WATERPROOF.info: This clothing <info>won't let water through</info>.  Unless you jump in the river or something like that.

WATER_FRIENDLY.info: This clothing <good>performs well</good> even when <info>soaking wet</info>. This can feel good.

POWERARMOR_EXO.info: This is a power armor exoskeleton.

POWERARMOR_EXTERNAL.info: This integrates with a power armor exoskeleton.

POWERARMOR_PLATING.info: This is a set of armor plating for a power armor exoskeleton.

POWERARMOR_MOD.info: This is a power armor modification.

POWERARMOR_COMPATIBLE.info: This item can be worn simultaneously with power armor.

ZOOM.info: This item can be used to <good>better</good> see <info>things far away</info>.

MAGIC_FOCUS.info: This item is a <info>magical focus</info>.  You can cast spells with it in your hand.

BAD_TASTE.info: This food is <bad>unappetizing</bad> in a way that <bad>can't be covered up by most cooking</bad>.

RAW.info: This food is <info>raw</info>, and will be <good>more nutritious</good> if cooked.

DRONE_CAM.info: This item <good>allows you to view</good> the position of enemies <info>marked by friendly drones</info>.

GNV_EFFECT.info: This gear <good>enhances your vision</good> when worn, and <info>tints your field of view</info>.

GNVE_EFFECT.info: This gear <good>greatly enhances your vision</good> when worn, and <info>tints your field of view</info>.

RECON_VISION.info: This gear <good>enhances your vision</good> when worn.

IR_EFFECT.info: This gear allows you to <good>see heat signatures</good> when worn.

STR_RELOAD.info: This weapon's <info>reload speed</info> is <good>increased by strength</good>.

NET_TANGLE.info: Thrown nets apply the NET_TANGLE ammo effect to nearby creatures.

TINDER.info: This item can be used as tinder in a firewood source, <info>automatically being used</info> to light fires if using a a firestarting tool that requires it.

UNDERWATER_GUN.info: This weapon is inherently <good>designed to work underwater</good>.

WATER_DISABLE.info: This item <bad>stops working</bad> when <info>submerged in water</info>.

WORN_GUN.info: This gun can be fired while <good>worn</good>.

HEAVY_WEAPON_SUPPORT.info: This equipment <good>allows you to fire</good> unwieldy weapons without requiring support from mountable terrain, as a <info>Large or Huge</info> mutant could, at the expense of <bad>reduced accuracy</bad>.

FLY_STRAIGHT.info: This thrown item <info>flies straight</info> without rotating in the air, maintaining its aerodynamic orientation.

WATERPROOF_GUN.info: This weapon <good>can shoot underwater</good>, but <info>unless it was specifically designed to do so</info>, it <bad>will suffer from accuracy penalty</bad>.

UNSAFE_CONSUME.info: This is unsafe to consume, so it won't be consumed when included in auto drink or eat zones.

BUTCHER_RACK.info: This item <good>can be used as a <info>butchering</info> rack</good>.

FLAT_SURFACE.info: This item <good>can be used as a flat surface</good> for <info>butchering</info>.

MELEE_GUNMOD.info: When attached to a gun, this item <good>contributes to its melee damage</good>.

ROOF.info: Keeps the rain out of the interior of the vehicle.

WEATHER_FORECAST.info: This item can show the <info>automated weather forecast</info>.

WINDMETER.info: This item can show the <info>current heading and speed of the wind</info> as well as <info>perceived temperature</info>.

HIDDEN.info: You have marked this article to not display a sprite when worn.

SLEEP_AID.info: This item provides comfort during sleep.

ALTERNATOR.info: An alternator.  When mounted on a gasoline or diesel engine and the engine is on, will produce electrical power that can be stored in a battery.

AISLE.info: You can move through this vehicle frame without being slowed down.

AISLE_LIGHT.info: A bright light that illuminates several squares inside the vehicle.

ARMOR.info: Armor plate.  Will partially protect other components on the same frame from damage from direct attacks but not from the shock damage of a distant collision.

BELTABLE.info: You can install a seat belt or five part harness here to help keep you in your seat during a collision.

CTRL_ELECTRONIC.info: You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').

CONTROLS.info: With a seat or saddle, you drive from here.  You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').

CONTROL_WITHOUT_HANDS.info: Allows you to fire two-handed weapons while driving.

COVERED.info: Illuminated items in this space will not illuminate nearby squares.

CURTAIN.info: Closed, it prevents people from seeing through the curtain.  A door motor allows you to remotely open or close it from the vehicle controls.

DOOR.info: When open, this part lets you move from inside the vehicle to outside or vice versa.  When closed, it prevents people from entering or leaving the vehicle.

ENABLED_DRAINS_EPOWER.info: When turned on, this device drains power from the vehicle's batteries.

ENGINE.info: Provides motive power to move the vehicle if the vehicle has sufficient wheels.  Requires controls to turn on.  If it drains power, also requires a charged battery to start.

E_ALTERNATOR.info: An alternator can be attached, and it will generate electrical power while the engine is on at the cost of some motive power.

EXTRA_DRAG.info: When turned on, it will stop the vehicle unless it has a strong engine.

FLOATS.info: Each boat hull will reduce the draft of your vehicle and increase the height sealed against water.  If the draft is less than the sealed height, your vehicle will float if placed in water.

NONBELTABLE.info: There's no place to attach a seat belt, so you get thrown from the vehicle in a crash.

SEAT.info: You need to be in a seat or saddle to operate vehicle controls.

SEATBELT.info: This part will help prevent you from being thrown from the vehicle in a collision.  You will automatically enable this part when you move into a tile with it.

SHOCK_ABSORBER.info: Armor plate.  Will partially protect other components on the same frame from the shock damage of a distant collision but not from direct attacks.

STABLE.info: If your vehicle consists of a single tile, this wheel is enough to allow it to move.

STEERABLE.info: Your vehicle needs at least one set of steerable wheels to turn.

TURRET.info: A heavy weapon mounted in a turret.  If your hands are empty, you can stand on the same tile as a mounted gun and 'f'ire the weapon.

WHEEL.info: If the center of balance of your vehicle is between all the wheels, the vehicle will be able to move, provided it has an active engine or motor with enough power to move the vehicle.

TRAP_PROOF.info: This wheel <info>hovers</info> and will <good>not set off traps</good> such as deep pits or landmines.

FLAT_SURF.info: This item <good>can be used as a flat surface</good> for <info>butchering</info>.

BUTCHER_EQ.info: This item <good>can be used as a butchering rack</good>.

POWER_DRAW_LINKED_PORTAL.info: This part can siphon power from a linked dimensional portal into the vehicle's battery system.  Must be linked by examining a compatible portal while the vehicle is nearby.

Chance to spawn: 1 / (MON_FUNGALOID_YOUNG_SPAWN_BASE_RATE + num_creatures_in_bubble / MON_FUNGALOID_YOUNG_SPAWN_BUBBLE_CREATURES_DIVIDER)

FUNGUS_ADVANCED_CREATURES_THRESHOLD.name: FUNGUS_ADVANCED_CREATURES_THRESHOLD
FUNGUS_ADVANCED_CREATURES_THRESHOLD.info: If number of creatures nearby will pass this threshold - chance to spawn spore by FUNGUS_ADVANCED attack will be proportionally decreased

ALLOW_LEARNING_BOOK_RECIPES.info: Allows learning recipes by reading books.

BALANCED_MUTATIONS.name: BALANCED_MUTATIONS
BALANCED_MUTATIONS.info: Makes mutation more balanced and interesting.

MANA_REGEN_IS_FLAT.info: A boolean for whether mana regen is a flat rate or based on regenerating all your mana in a given number of hours

MANA_REGEN_HOURS_RATE.name: MANA_REGEN_HOURS_RATE
MANA_REGEN_HOURS_RATE.info: The integer number of hours that it should take for the player's mana to fully regenerate by default.

MANA_REGEN_FLAT.name: MANA_REGEN_FLAT

MAGIC_STAT_SCALING_PERCENT.name: MAGIC_STAT_SCALING_PERCENT
MAGIC_STAT_SCALING_PERCENT.info: The percentage bonus (or malus) that each point away from the base 8 should get you (i.e. 10 is 10%).

UNDERGROUND_TEMPERATURE_INFLUENCED_BY_SU.name: UNDERGROUND_TEMPERATURE_INFLUENCED_BY_SURFACE
UNDERGROUND_TEMPERATURE_INFLUENCED_BY_SU.info: If true, underground temperatures are influenced by surface weather conditions. At z=-1 (50% influence), z=-2 (25%), z<=-3 (0%, annual average only).

AVATAR_LEVEL_XP_COEFF.name: AVATAR_LEVEL_XP_COEFF
AVATAR_LEVEL_XP_COEFF.info: An integer coefficient for determining the XP thresholds for leveling up in STK and similar

ALWAYS_SHOW_MANA.name: ALWAYS_SHOW_MANA
ALWAYS_SHOW_MANA.info: If true, always display the mana in the sidebar. Primarily useful for magic-related mods.

SKILL_TRAINING_SPEED.name: SKILL_TRAINING_SPEED
SKILL_TRAINING_SPEED.info: A multiplier on the amount of XP you gain from skills. 0 completely disables it (a la skills through kills)

PATHFINDING_DEFAULT_IS_OVERRIDE.name: PATHFINDING_DEFAULT_IS_OVERRIDE
PATHFINDING_DEFAULT_IS_OVERRIDE.info: If true, default is applied even if the value IS specified. This makes all monsters pathfind the same.

PATHFINDING_H_COEFF_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_H_COEFF_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_H_COEFF_DEFAULT.info: If `h_coeff` is unspecified, it will be this: how directed the pathfinding is. A value of 1.0 makes pathfinding equivalent to A*, 0.0 is raw Dijikstra; this adjusts precision, high values will converge quicker, but produce a possibly less than shortest path.

PATHFINDING_ALPHA_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_ALPHA_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_ALPHA_DEFAULT.info: If `alpha` is unspecified, it will be this: alpha coefficient is a coefficient that makes pathfinding sometimes take slightly less than most optimal tiles. 1.0 only allows taking the best tiles, 0 will pick any _better_ tile that current one, not necessarily the best one. Use it to make pathfinding more 'flowy' and to decongest routes

PATHFINDING_SEARCH_RADIUS_COEFF_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_SEARCH_RADIUS_COEFF_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_SEARCH_RADIUS_COEFF_DEFAULT.info: If `search_radius_coeff` is unspecified, the value will be this: limits pathfinding search domain, will include tiles within the circle centered at the midpoint between start position and end position of diameter equal to the distance between said points multiplied by this coefficient. Setting this less that 1 will make pathfinding always fail. Negative values will disable search radius limit. Be aware, this forces pathfinding to be redone on each call, which is expensive.

PATHFINDING_SEARCH_CONE_ANGLE_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_SEARCH_CONE_ANGLE_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_SEARCH_CONE_ANGLE_DEFAULT.info: If `search_cone_angle` is unspecified, the value will be this: limits pathfinding search domain, will include tiles within a cone of this angle starting from start position and going towards end position. A value of 180 and more disables search cone. Be aware, this forces pathfinding to be redone on each call, which is expensive.

PATHFINDING_RANGE_MULT.name: PATHFINDING_RANGE_MULT
PATHFINDING_RANGE_MULT.info: Multiply specified `max_dist` and `max_length` by this value. If set to negative, makes both infinite, allowing any distance pathfinding.

PATHFINDING_MAX_F_LIMIT_BASED_ON_MAX_DIS.name: PATHFINDING_MAX_F_LIMIT_BASED_ON_MAX_DIST
PATHFINDING_MAX_F_LIMIT_BASED_ON_MAX_DIS.info: Use specified `max_dist` instead of distance between the start position and the end position when limiting search domain based on unbiased f-values: this replicates `max_length` constraint used by legacy pathfinding. This makes maximum allowed produced path complexity depend on how close the target position is to the start position.

PATHFINDING_MAX_F_COEFF_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_MAX_F_COEFF_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_MAX_F_COEFF_DEFAULT.info: If max_f_coeff is unspecified, the value will be this: limits pathfinding search domain based on unbiased f-values: this will make pathfinding not succeed when the f-value is more than this value multiplied by either the distance between the start position and the end position or by `max_dist` is the option is enabled. 2.5 is equivalent to legacy pathfinding, negative values disable the limit.

PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_DEFAULT.name: PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_DEFAULT.info: If mob avoidance is unspecified, the value will be this. This makes pathfinding route around living mobs with higher values increasing the route-around range. Negative values will make pathfinding treat mobs as impassable walls.

PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_NPC_DEF.name: PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_NPC_DEFAULT
PATHFINDING_MOB_PRESENCE_PENALTY_NPC_DEF.info: Mob avoidance penalty applied to NPC and player pathfinding. Higher values increase the route-around range. Negative values treat mobs as impassable walls.
